Abstract: Vision-language models remain underused in colonoscopy despite the rich expert descriptions recorded in routine reports. These reports document lesion appearance, size and location but summarise entire procedures rather than caption individual frames, leaving clinical findings only weakly linked to the corresponding images. Here we develop EndoCLIP, a colonoscopy vision-language foundation model trained on 125,756 lesion-level image-text pairs progressively recovered from 280,476 routine colonoscopy records. Across lesion-level image-text retrieval, structured report generation and six multi-centre clinical classification tasks, EndoCLIP outperforms general-purpose and biomedical vision-language encoders in both zero-shot and linear-probe settings. On benign-versus-malignant classification, its linear probe approaches the performance of expert readers in a blinded study involving 12 endoscopists. These results suggest that recovering finding-to-frame correspondence can transform routine documentation into scalable supervision, enabling clinical targets to be specified in language rather than separately annotated for each task.

</details>


### [291] [Towards Autonomous Aircraft Surveillance from Nanosatellites through On-Board Inference and Generative Data Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28470)
*Antonio Delgado-Rosa,David Muñoz-Valero,Enrique Adrian Villarrubia-Martin,Juan Moreno-Garcia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合星上推理与生成式数据增强的工作流，用于解决纳米卫星低轨空中监视中下行带宽受限与航空数据集稀缺且类别不平衡的两大瓶颈。推理在搭载低功耗边缘张量加速器的6U CubeSat上执行，扩散模型通过低秩适配微调生成合成少数类图像并自动伪标注，与经典增强样本合并形成平衡数据集。结果显示全局mAP从77.9%提升至82.2%，少数类F1从0.683提升至0.811，量化检测器适配星上存储并支持在轨25-30帧/秒推理，支持其作为实时自主空中监视的决策辅助工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纳米卫星在近地轨道进行空中监视面临两个相互关联的瓶颈：一是下行链路预算有限，但传统方案仍将数TB原始图像传回地面处理，导致决策延迟；二是开放航空卫星数据集稀缺且类别严重不平衡，阻碍标准检测器学习稀有飞机类别的鲁棒表征。这两个问题需要联合解决。

Method: 提出一个结合星上推理与生成式数据增强的工作流：(1) 推理在配备低功耗边缘张量加速器的6U CubeSat上执行；(2) 通过低秩适配（LoRA）微调扩散模型，生成合成少数类航空图像；(3) 生成的合成图像由中间检测器自动伪标注并与经典增强样本合并，形成类别平衡的训练数据集；(4) 检测器经量化后适配星上内存。

Result: 平衡数据集使全局平均精度（mAP）从77.9%提升至82.2%，少数类F1分数从0.683提升至0.811；量化后的检测器适配星上芯片内存，支持在轨25-30帧/秒的推理速度。

Conclusion: 计算实验支持所提出的工作流可作为纳米卫星实时、自主空中监视的决策辅助工具，与卫星仅作为被动数据采集器的传统弯管式架构形成鲜明对比。

Abstract: Airborne surveillance from low Earth orbit is hindered by two interconnected bottlenecks: nanosatellites have a limited downlink budget, yet the conventional approach still transmits terabytes of raw imagery to the ground for processing, and open satellite datasets for aircraft are scarce and severely class-imbalanced. These limitations either delay timely decision-making or prevent standard detectors from learning robust representations of rare aircraft classes. In this paper, a workflow that combines on-board inference with generative data augmentation is proposed to address both limitations jointly. Inference is executed on a 6U CubeSat equipped with a low-power edge tensor accelerator, while a diffusion model fine-tuned through low-rank adaptation generates synthetic minority-class imagery. This synthetic output is automatically annotated, pseudo-labelled, by an intermediate detector and merged with classically augmented samples. The results show that the balanced dataset increases global mean average precision from 77.9% to 82.2%, with the minority class rising from F1=0.683 to F1=0.811, and that the quantised detector fits the on-chip memory and projects 25-30 frames per second on orbit. This approach contrasts with the conventional bent-pipe architecture, in which the satellite acts as a passive data collector. Therefore, the computational tests support the proposed workflow as a decision-support tool for real-time, autonomous airborne surveillance from nanosatellites.

</details>


### [292] [A Fuzzy Rule-based Neuro-Symbolic Approach for Pipe Severity Prediction in Sewer Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28481)
*Ngoc Thai Le,Thanh Ma,Umberto Straccia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个模块化的模糊规则神经符号框架，将Swin Transformer感知模块与决策树转化的模糊IF-THEN规则推理模块解耦，用于自动下水道管道严重程度评估。在3,244张图像上，相比仅依赖图像分类的方法，在准确率、平衡准确率、Macro F1和MCC上分别提升17.9%、12.2%、23.0%和17.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自动下水道管道严重程度评估依赖直接图像分类形成"黑箱"，视觉缺陷与最终严重度评分之间的关联是隐式的，缺乏可解释性。作者希望通过解耦神经感知与符号推理来弥合这一缺口，提供可追溯的推理链。

Method: 框架分为两部分：感知模块使用Swin Transformer直接从图像预测14个多标签检测CODE等级；推理模块使用Weka J48决策树在真实CODE和严重度标签上训练，将树路径转化为19条固定IF-THEN规则。推理通过模糊逻辑执行：使用t-norm（Product、Łukasiewicz、Hamacher）激活CODE条件，按规则置信度加权，并结合相应s-norm生成可解释的类别证据。地面真值标签通过五个独立大语言模型对原始检查员注释的共识生成。

Result: 在3,244张图像、五个高度不平衡严重度类别的数据集上，相比纯图像分类方法，准确率提升17.9%，平衡准确率提升12.2%，Macro F1提升23.0%，MCC提升17.3%。评估了三种模糊算子对（Product、Łukasiewicz、Hamacher）。

Conclusion: 该框架在保持竞争性类别平衡性能的同时，提供了从预测CODE等级到规则支持再到严重度证据的可追溯推理链条，实现了准确性、可解释性和公平性的平衡。

Abstract: Standard automated sewer pipe severity assessment relies on direct image classification, creating a "black box" where the link between visual defects and final severity scores remains implicit. This study introduces a modular, fuzzy rule-based neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by decoupling neural perception from symbolic reasoning. The perception module utilizes a Swin Transformer to predict 14 multilabel inspection CODE degrees directly from images. For reasoning, a DT, specifically Weka's J48, algorithm is trained on ground-truth CODEs and severity labels, and its paths are converted into 19 fixed IF--THEN rules. Inference operates via fuzzy logic: t-norm activations from CODE conditions are weighted by rule confidence and combined with corresponding s-norms to produce interpretable class evidence. We assessed Product, Łukasiewicz, and Hamacher operator pairs using a dataset of 3,244 images spanning five highly imbalanced severity classes. Ground-truth labels were robustly generated via consensus from five independent large language models analyzing original inspector notes. Our results show an improvement of accuracy, balanced accuracy, Macro F1 and MCC by 17.9%, 12.2%, 23.0%, and 17.3%, respectively, over image-only based classification.
  Overall, the framework combines competitive class-balanced performance with traceable reasoning from predicted CODE degrees to rule supports and severity evidence.

</details>


### [293] [SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28488)
*Yunhao Liang,Xianqi Cao,Pujun Zhang,Yuan Qu,Yongzhi Qi,Ningxuan Kang,Max Z. J. Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE框架，将供应链补货计划中的多阶段决策（选品、货源分配、补货频率、路径规划）建模为统一的复合策略模型，通过共享运营表示和系统级效用实现端到端协调优化，在叮咚买菜和京东的真实数据上验证了其优于分阶段独立优化的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 供应链补货计划涉及选品、货源分配、补货频率和配送路径等多个紧密耦合的决策，但传统上由不同部门通过独立系统分别优化，导致缺货、库存积压和不必要的运输成本。作者希望通过统一协调这些跨部门运营耦合来提升端到端供应链决策效果。

Method: 提出SCOPE框架：将供应链实体表示为token，通过共享运营表示进行上下文编码，再将每种token类型映射到对应的决策接口。每个决策逐步建立在先前决策形成的部分计划之上，最终使用共享的系统级效用函数评估完整计划。在urban fresh-retail补货场景中实例化，并基于叮咚买菜和JD.com的真实运营数据评估。

Result: 在两个不同补货梯级的大规模供应链数据集上，SCOPE均一致优于分阶段独立优化的方法以及供应链运营中常用的实践导向基线方法。

Conclusion: 学习和协调跨部门运营耦合能够带来更有效的端到端供应链决策，表明供应链AI有望从孤立的决策模块走向统一的操作规划。

Abstract: Can supply-chain AI move beyond isolated decision modules toward unified operational planning? A complete replenishment plan specifies which products each location carries, which upstream facility supplies it, how often it is replenished, and how deliveries are routed. These decisions are operationally coupled: the selected assortment changes the demand and load passed to later stages; source assignment and replenishment frequency reshape the delivery requests; and route feasibility and cost, in turn, determine the system value of the earlier choices. Yet in modern supply chains, these decisions are often handled by separate departments and optimized through separate systems, which can lead to stockouts, inventory exposure, and avoidable transportation. We propose SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination, a composite policy model that represents supply-chain entities as tokens, contextualizes them through a shared operational representation, and maps each token type to the corresponding decision interface. Each decision builds on the partial plan formed by earlier decisions while the completed plan is evaluated using a shared system-level utility. We instantiate this framework in urban fresh-retail replenishment, where service frequency, assortment, capacity pressure, and road-network routing interact strongly, and evaluate it on real operational data from Dingdong and JD.com, two large-scale supply chains operating at different replenishment echelons. Across both settings, SCOPE consistently outperforms methods that optimize each decision stage separately, as well as practice-oriented baselines commonly used in supply-chain operations. These results show that learning and coordinating cross-department operational couplings lead to more effective end-to-end supply-chain decisions.

</details>


### [294] [InfoOps Bench: A live information operations safety benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28503)
*Dorian Quelle,Lisa-Maria Neudert,Jonathan Bright,John Gallacher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个动态更新的AI基准测试（InfoOpsBench），用于评估前沿大语言模型被国家支持的信息操作（俄罗斯、中国、伊朗）所利用的完整性。测试了8家提供商的17个模型，发现大多数模型可被用于信息操作，诚信得分从8.8%到94.5%不等，且中国开发的模型在涉及中国相关批评性声明时明显降低合规性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 防止前沿语言模型被国家支持的信息操作所利用，现有静态基准容易饱和，需要一个动态、持续更新的基准来评估模型在这一领域的完整性和安全性。

Method: 从实时监控管道中收集2000多个信息操作案例，追踪俄罗斯、中国和伊朗的国家支持信息资产；通过伴侣网站每周更新基准；使用四种提示框架测试17个模型（来自8家提供商），以拒绝率衡量诚信得分，并分析模型在事实依据明确的批评性声明上的表现差异。

Result: 多数模型可被用于信息操作；诚信得分范围8.8%-94.5%，跨度达85.7个百分点且与模型大小无关；模型选择改变了操作特性（编造细节、弱化声明、查证率2.9%-72.9%不等）；除Z.ai的GLM 5.2外，中国开发的模型在中国批评性声明上合规性骤降48-70个百分点。

Conclusion: 模型对信息操作的诚信与其对良性内容的生产意愿部分相关；在模型可用性与安全性之间存在需要平衡的挑战。中国的模型在涉及本国批评性内容时存在显著的行为偏移，这是部署和治理时需要考虑的重要发现。

Abstract: In this paper we present an active, constantly updated AI benchmark which measures the integrity of frontier language models against being co-opted for state-backed information operations. We draw on over 2,100 information operations from a live monitoring pipeline which tracks Russian, Chinese and Iranian state-backed information assets. Alongside this paper, we release a companion website that tracks the most prominent claims spread by state-backed media outlets, updated weekly, available from: pattrn.ai/research/infoopsbench. The dynamic nature of the benchmark makes it resistant to saturation.
  In the benchmark, we test 17 models from 8 providers across four prompt framings. We find that most models can be co-opted for information operations. Integrity scores, defined as the percentage of refused requests, range from 8.8% to 94.5%, an 85.7-percentage-point spread not explained by model size. Model choice also changes the character of the resulting operation. Some models fabricate details and produce output more harmful than the source material, others defuse claims even while complying, and fact-checking rates vary from 2.9% to 72.9%.
  Integrity against information operations is at least partly related to refusal to produce content even for benign claims, illustrating the challenge of balancing model usability with safety. With one exception (Z.ai's GLM 5.2), the Chinese-developed models sharply cut compliance on factually grounded but China-critical claims, dropping 48-70 percentage points relative to matched benign claims.

</details>


### [295] [Selective Credibility-Limited Belief Update](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28523)
*Theofanis Aravanis,Costas D. Koutras*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出选择性可信度限制信念更新（selective credibility-limited belief update），将复合认知输入按源世界转换为弱化代理后再进行可信度限制转换，捕捉仅部分认知输入可实现的情形，统一了标准Katsuno-Mendelzon更新与可信度限制更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可信度限制信念更新方法将认知输入视为不可分割的整体，无法表达复合认知输入中仅部分可被实现的情况。标准Katsuno-Mendelzon更新假设每个初始可能世界都能完整吸收认知输入，而可信度限制更新虽然对每个源世界限制后继可信世界，但仍未解决认知输入可分割采纳的问题。

Method: 提出选择性可信度限制信念更新框架，核心思想是在每个源世界处先将原始认知输入转换为较弱的代理公式，再执行可信度限制转换。提供语义刻画（基于选择性转换函数与可信度限制关系）和公理化表征。进一步识别两个良性子类：一致性保持更新算子（要求一致的原始输入所转换的代理在各源世界均可信）和最大一致性保持更新算子（额外要求代理在原始输入的可信后果中信息量最大）。

Result: 给出了新算子类的语义与公理系统；证明可信度限制信念更新是该框架的特例（当转换函数为恒等时），Katsuno-Mendelzon信念更新在移除可信度限制且转换函数为恒等时自然涌现。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一个统一且更具表达力的信念更新体系，涵盖已有方法并支持依赖源世界的选择性接受，弥补了现有方法在部分认知输入可实现场景下的表达缺陷。

Abstract: Belief update concerns changes in an agent's beliefs induced by changes in the underlying world. Standard Katsuno-Mendelzon update assumes that an epistemic input can be incorporated from every initially possible world, whereas credibility-limited belief update restricts, for each source world, the successor worlds regarded as credible or reachable. Nevertheless, existing credibility-limited approaches treat the epistemic input as an indivisible whole, and therefore cannot represent cases in which only part of a compound epistemic input can be realized. We introduce selective credibility-limited belief update, in which the epistemic input is transformed, relative to each source world, into a weaker proxy before the credibility-limited transition is performed. We provide semantic and axiomatic characterizations of the resulting class of update operators. We then identify two well-behaved sub-classes; namely, consistency-preserving update operators, which require every transformed epistemic input to be credible from its source world whenever the original epistemic input is consistent, and maximal consistency-preserving update operators, which additionally require the selected proxy to be maximally informative among the credible consequences of the original epistemic input. Finally, we establish the generality of the proposed framework by showing that credibility-limited belief update is recovered as a special case, while Katsuno--Mendelzon belief update emerges when credibility restrictions are removed and the transformation functions are taken to be identities. These results demonstrate that the framework provides a unified and strictly more expressive account of belief update, encompassing established approaches while supporting source-dependent selective acceptance.

</details>


### [296] [MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28527)
*Mao-xun Huang,Jerry Wang,Yi-Cheng Lai,Zhengxin Zhang,Claire Cardie,Hen-Hsen Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MANTA是一个多智能体网络拓扑自适应框架，使通信结构在推理时自我演化。它在五个基准上达到74.0的平均分，比最强基线高出5.8个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体系统通常将通信拓扑视为固定设计或离线优化目标，缺乏在推理阶段动态调整协作结构的能力。随着任务复杂度提升，固定拓扑可能无法适应变化的任务需求。

Method: MANTA在部署前从先验结构经验初始化任务条件化的拓扑；部署期间监控协作轨迹，并在当前组织不足时施加有界结构更新，可修改智能体角色、通信链路、执行顺序、信息可见性和验证路径，同时保留任务接口和智能体预算。

Result: 在五个基准（信息检索、工具使用、规划、工作流执行、数学推理）上，MANTA取得最高平均分74.0，超越最强基线5.8个百分点，并在PlanCraft基准上取得最佳结果。

Conclusion: 推理过程中的自我改进可以扩展到协作架构本身，验证了多智能体系统结构层面动态自适应能力的有效性。

Abstract: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through task decomposition, agent specialization, information exchange, and intermediate validation. However, existing systems typically treat communication topology as a fixed design choice or an offline optimization target. We introduce MANTA, a framework for Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation that enables communication structures to self-evolve at inference time. Before execution, MANTA initializes a task-conditioned topology from prior structural experience. During deployment, it monitors collaboration traces and applies bounded structural updates when the current organization becomes insufficient. These updates can modify agent roles, communication links, execution order, information visibility, and validation pathways while preserving the task interface and agent budget. We evaluate MANTA against representative single-agent and multi-agent baselines on five benchmarks spanning information seeking, tool use, planning, workflow execution, and mathematical reasoning. MANTA achieves the highest average score of 74.0, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.8 percentage points and obtaining the best result on PlanCraft. These results show that inference-time self-improvement can extend to the architecture of collaboration itself.

</details>


### [297] [Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28573)
*Woongkyu Lee,Jungwook Choi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了在资源受限的本地环境中，推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）对自主电脑使用智能体（CUA）性能的影响，发现在上下文、时间、结构和并行四个维度上，额外的计算往往带来递减的回报，并改变失败模式，最终提出本地CUA需要选择性计算分配、失败感知控制机制和针对本地模型特性设计的智能体框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地部署自主电脑使用智能体（CUA）对隐私、成本效率和实际可用性越来越重要，但在严格的硬件约束下提升其性能仍具挑战。虽然已有研究表明推理时扩展可以改善前沿CUA的性能，但其对资源受限的本地模型是否有效仍不清楚，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在OSWorld基准上对Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B、UI-TARS-1.5-7B和OpenCUA-7B等本地模型进行了系统性实证研究，从上下文（contextual）、时间（temporal）、结构（structural）和并行（parallel）四个维度考察推理时扩展的影响，并分析不同扩展方式带来的收益与失败模式变化。

Result: 研究发现：1）上下文扩展提供历史基础信息，改善轨迹稳定性和任务准确率，但收益随token成本增加而饱和，失败模式从重复或停滞轨迹转向过早的虚假成功；2）时间扩展减少最大步数停滞，但未显著提升任务成功率，说明更长的推理视野往往延长错误轨迹而非纠正它们；3）结构分解在本地两阶段智能体中引入规划和格式化开销；4）并行扩展虽能部分缓解这些失败，但代价是显著增加的计算成本。

Conclusion: 高效的本地CUA需要选择性计算分配、失败感知控制机制，以及围绕本地模型的能力与局限性设计的智能体框架，而非简单依赖更大规模的推理时计算。

Abstract: Deploying autonomous computer-use agents (CUAs) locally is increasingly important for privacy, cost efficiency, and practical usability, yet improving their performance under strict hardware constraints remains challenging. While recent studies show that inference-time scaling can improve frontier computer-use agents through additional computation during execution, its effectiveness for resource-constrained local models remains poorly understood. We present a systematic empirical study of inference-time scaling in local CUAs across contextual, temporal, structural, and parallel dimensions. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B, UI-TARS-1.5-7B, and OpenCUA-7B on the OSWorld benchmark. Our results show that additional computation often yields diminishing returns while changing failure modes. Contextual scaling provides historical grounding that improves trajectory stability and task accuracy, but its gains saturate as token cost increases and failures shift from repetitive or stalled trajectories toward premature false successes. Temporal scaling similarly reduces max-step stalls, yet does not substantially improve task success, indicating that longer horizons often extend erroneous trajectories rather than correct them. We further find that structural decomposition can introduce planning and formatting overhead in local two-stage agents, while parallel scaling partially mitigates these failures at a substantial computational cost. Overall, our findings suggest that efficient local CUAs require selective compute allocation, failure-aware control mechanisms, and agentic frameworks designed around the capabilities and limitations of local models.

</details>


### [298] [DualG-MRAG: Decoupling Macro-Reasoning and Micro-Matching for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28580)
*Jiacheng Tao,Qingyun Sun,Haonan Yuan,Ziwei Zhang,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DualG-MRAG，一种双层级框架（宏观推理图+微观匹配图）用于多模态检索增强生成，通过解耦全局结构化推理与细粒度证据匹配，并利用GNN检索器和动态规划解码来提升多跳复杂问答的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MM-RAG在处理复杂多跳推理任务时表现不佳：实例级匹配无法捕获跨模态、跨文档的显式关系；图增强方法面临两难困境——引入细粒度视觉特征会导致图膨胀和检索噪声，而粗粒度表示又会丢失关键局部证据。

Method: 提出双层级解耦架构DualG-MRAG：构建Macro Graph（宏观图）用于全局拓扑路由，Micro Graph（微观图）用于精确局部验证，从而将全局结构推理与细粒度证据匹配隔离以抑制噪声；将检索建模为查询驱动的消息传递过程，通过GNN Retriever实现跨异质证据源的动态相关性传播；引入动态规划解码机制，直接从GNN前向传播中提取显式推理路径，替代孤立文档块的输入。

Result: 大量实验表明DualG-MRAG在证据召回率和复杂问答准确率上均优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过解耦宏观推理与微观匹配的双图架构，DualG-MRAG有效解决了多模态RAG中图膨胀与局部证据丢失之间的权衡问题，为复杂多跳多模态推理提供了一种结构化的检索与生成方案。

Abstract: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) has shown promising results, it still struggles with complex multi-hop reasoning tasks. Existing methods primarily focus on independent instance-level matching, which often fails to capture explicit relationships across modalities and documents. Although Graph-enhanced methods introduce structural modeling, they face a fundamental challenge in multimodal scenarios: incorporating fine-grained visual features leads to rapid graph expansion and retrieval noise, whereas coarse-grained representations cause the discarding of critical local evidence. To address this dilemma, we propose DualG-MRAG, a Dual-tier framework that introduces a decoupled architecture comprising Macro-reasoning and Micro-matching Graphs for Multimodal RAG. Specifically, to suppress retrieval noise by isolating global structural reasoning from fine-grained evidence matching, we construct a Macro Graph for global topological routing and a Micro Graph for precise local verification. Subsequently, to enable dynamic relevance propagation across heterogeneous evidence sources, we formulate retrieval as a query-driven message passing process via a GNN Retriever. Furthermore, to provide the generative model with coherent structural guidance, we introduce a dynamic programming decoding mechanism that extracts explicit reasoning paths directly from the GNN's forward pass, replacing the standard input of isolated document chunks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DualG-MRAG outperforms baselines in both evidence recall and complex QA accuracy.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [299] [Analog Courant Numbers and their Role in Analog Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27609)
*Arash Ghasemi*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文识别出模拟计算（阻抗网络表示矩阵行）中的一个动力学约束：最快的归一化模式不超过最大组合单位增益带宽（CUGBW）的2π倍。CUGBW等于该行的有限增益调整单位增益带宽加上所有耦合行的贡献。该约束与时间步进方法中的Courant数限制类似，限制了模拟硬件可物理表示和解析的算子速率。理论通过大规模LTspice仿真验证，涵盖CMOS到热离子真空管架构，基准电路包括一维热方程、图半监督学习和图正则化回归。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟计算作为一种高效的计算范式日益受到关注，但对其动力学极限的严格理论分析仍然匮乏。作者旨在建立模拟阻抗网络计算的基本动力学约束，类似于数值方法中的Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy（CFL）条件，从而为模拟硬件设计的可行边界提供理论指导。

Method: 作者从阻抗网络表示矩阵行的模拟计算框架出发，定义并推导了组合单位增益带宽（CUGBW）的概念——其等于有限增益调整的单位增益带宽加上所有耦合行的贡献，其中每个贡献为两行单位增益带宽乘积与耦合电导的平方根，再除以总电导负载乘积的平方根。通过数学推导证明了最快归一化模式的上界为2π乘以最大CUGBW，并在大规模LTspice仿真中跨多种硬件架构（CMOS和热离子真空管）验证该理论。

Result: 理论推导给出了模拟计算动力学模式的严格上界，即最快归一化模式不大于最大CUGBW的2π倍。该界限在所有测试的架构（CMOS与热离子真空管）和基准问题（热方程、图半监督学习、图正则化回归）的LTspice仿真中均得到验证。

Conclusion: 模拟计算硬件存在固有的动力学带宽限制，该限制与数值时间步进中的Courant数限制在功能上类似。这为模拟硬件的设计提供了可操作的性能边界准则，即通过CUGBW来评估和约束可实现的算子速率，对模拟计算的架构选型和电路设计具有重要指导意义。

Abstract: This paper identifies a dynamical constraint on analog-computing approaches in which a row of the matrix is represented by an impedance network. It shows that the fastest normalized mode is no more than $2π$ times the largest combined unity-gain bandwidth (CUGBW) among all the circuit rows. The CUGBW of a row equals its finite-gain-adjusted unity-gain bandwidth plus the contributions of all rows coupled to it. Each contribution is the square root of the product of the two rows' unity-gain bandwidths multiplied by their coupling conductance and divided by the square root of the product of their total conductance loadings. This bound plays a role analogous to the Courant-number restriction in time-stepping methods by limiting the operator rates that analog hardware can physically represent and resolve at its outputs. The theory is validated using large-scale LTspice simulations across architectures ranging from CMOS to thermionic vacuum-tube circuits. The benchmark circuits implement a one-dimensional heat equation, a graph-based semi-supervised learning problem, and a graph-regularized regression.

</details>


### [300] [GyRot: Leveraging Hidden Synergy between Rotation and Fine-grained Group Quantization for Low-bit LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27694)
*Sangjin Kim,Yuseon Choi,Byeongcheol Kim,Jungjun Oh,Hoi-jun Yoo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: GyRot是一个通过算法-硬件协同设计将旋转（rotation）与细粒度分组量化（group quantization）有效结合的量化框架及硬件加速器，解决了二者结合时因全局性与局部性不匹配导致的精度下降和硬件开销问题，在保持最先进的4位精度同时实现了最高3.4倍加速和3.6倍能效提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特量化对高效LLM推理至关重要，旋转和细粒度分组量化虽各自表现出潜力，但两者的组合常因旋转的全局特性与分组缩放的局部行为不匹配而导致精度退化或硬件开销增加，需要弥合这一差距。

Method: GyRot采用算法-硬件协同设计：(1) 提出CoRFiG（粗粒度旋转、细粒度分组）和HAP（谐波对齐置换）实现旋转与分组量化的协同集成，增强可量化性同时放宽缩放因子精度要求；(2) 重构非对称量化并提出零点舍入策略，实现全整数反量化；(3) 基于INT4张量PE架构实现。

Result: 在LLaMA系列模型上取得最先进的4位精度，相比基线LLM加速器实现最高3.4倍速度提升和3.6倍能效提升。

Conclusion: 结果验证了GyRot在大规模、高能效LLM部署中的实际有效性与实用性。

Abstract: Low-bit quantization is essential for efficient LLM inference, and both rotation and fine-grained group quantization have shown individual promise. However, their combination often leads to accuracy degradation or hardware overhead due to a mismatch between the global nature of rotation and the localized behavior of group scaling. We propose GyRot, a quantization framework and hardware accelerator that bridges this gap through algorithm-hardware co-design. GyRot introduces Coarse Rotation, Fine Grouping (CoRFiG) and Harmonic-Aligned Permutation (HAP) to enable cooperative integration of rotation and group quantization, enhancing quantizability while relaxing scaling factor precision. To further reduce hardware cost, we reformulate asymmetric quantization and introduce a zero-point rounding strategy that enables fully integer dequantization. Implemented on an INT4-based tensor PE architecture, GyRot achieves state-of-the-art 4-bit accuracy across LLaMA-family models, while delivering up to 3.4x speedup and 3.6x energy efficiency over baseline LLM accelerators. These results validate GyRot's practical effectiveness for scalable and energy-efficient LLM deployment.

</details>


### [301] [LightRot: A Light-Weighted Rotation Scheme and Architecture for Accurate Low-Bit Large Language Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27704)
*Sangjin Kim,Yuseon Choi,Jungjun Oh,Byeongcheol Kim,Hoi-Jun Yoo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了LightRot，一种用于低比特LLM推理的轻量级旋转方案及其专用硬件加速器。它结合了分组局部旋转（GLR）和异常方向对齐（ODA）算法，以及基于分层快速Hadamard变换（FHT）的旋转单元，在28nm CMOS工艺下实现了27.4 TOPS/W的峰值能效（4-bit推理），超越了现有最先进设计，并在LLaMA2-13B和LLaMA3-8B等先进模型及MT-Bench基准上进行了验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM在各个领域展现卓越能力，实现能效高且准确的推理变得日益关键。现有低比特量化方法面临旋转运算带来的能量开销等核心挑战，且多数方法依赖于高精度推理或仅在GPT-2等基础语言建模任务上评估，缺乏对先进大模型和真实对话场景的适配。

Method: LightRot设计了分层的快速Hadamard变换（FHT）旋转单元硬件架构，集成了两种算法：分组局部旋转（GLR）和异常方向对齐（ODA），以协同解决低比特量化中的旋转开销问题，并针对LLaMA2-13B和LLaMA3-8B等先进模型进行优化。

Result: 在28nm CMOS工艺下实现，4-bit推理取得27.4 TOPS/W的峰值能效，超越此前最先进设计；在MT-Bench基准上验证了其对真实对话场景的鲁棒适用性。

Conclusion: LightRot通过算法创新与硬件能效的协同，为可扩展的低比特LLM推理树立了新范式，为可持续AI发展铺平了道路，并重新定义了基于对话的AI系统评估基准。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to demonstrate exceptional capabilities across various domains, the challenge of achieving energy-efficient and accurate inference becomes increasingly critical. This work presents LightRot, a lightweight rotation scheme and dedicated hardware accelerator designed for low-bit LLM inference. The proposed architecture integrates Grouped Local Rotation (GLR) and Outlier Direction Aligning (ODA) algorithms with a hierarchical Fast Hadamard Transform (FHT)-based rotation unit to address key challenges in low-bit quantization, including the energy overhead of rotation operations. The proposed accelerator, implemented in a 28nm CMOS process, achieves a peak energy efficiency of 27.4 TOPS/W for 4-bit inference, surpassing prior state-of-the-art designs. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on higher-precision inference or evaluate on basic language modeling tasks like GPT-2, LightRot is optimized for advanced models such as LLaMA2-13B and LLaMA3-8B. Its performance is further validated on MT-Bench, demonstrating robust applicability to real-world conversational scenarios and redefining benchmarks for chat-based AI systems. By synergizing algorithmic innovations and hardware efficiency, this work sets a new paradigm for scalable, low-bit LLM inference, paving the way for sustainable AI advancements.

</details>


### [302] [ARES: Adaptive Reasoning-Effort Steering for PPA- and Cost-Aware RTL Optimization with LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27879)
*Stef Cuyckens,Mihaela Jivanescu,Jun Yin,Chao Fang,Marian Verhelst*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Ares是一个面向LLM驱动的RTL设计PPA优化的代理系统，通过引入归一化美元成本、重新评估长期记忆的价值，以及采用自适应的逐调用推理努力策略，在同等成本下显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代理在RTL设计PPA优化中存在三个关键缺陷：一是未报告归一化成本，导致不同努力级别和优化器之间无法公平比较；二是将性能提升盲目归因于工程化的跨设计记忆，缺乏严谨验证；三是所有调用的推理努力固定不变，造成计算资源的浪费。

Method: Ares提出三项创新：(1) 引入每次LLM调用的归一化美元成本，与品质因数（FoM）一并报告，实现跨努力级别和优化器的公平比较；(2) 通过该成本核算发现，构造精心设计的长期记忆与简单拼接相同经验相比并无可靠增益，从而否定了工程化记忆的必要性；(3) 采用自适应推理努力策略，通过耐心计数器（在21个训练设计上拟合）仅在低努力级别进展停滞时升级到更深的推理，将推理资源分配给真正需要的地方而非均匀分配。

Result: 在三个未见于训练的测试设计上，努力策略将FoM降低了23-27%，而最佳固定努力只能达到16-23%，且归一化成本相同。Ares将LLM草稿的乘累加单元与手工高度优化版本之间的差距缩小了高达83%，并以Dr. RTL 12%的token消耗达到比其深25%的FoM。

Conclusion: Ares证明了在LLM驱动的RTL优化中，成本归一化核算对于公平评估至关重要；长期记忆的工程化设计并非性能提升的关键；自适应推理努力分配能更有效地利用计算资源，在同等成本下取得更好的PPA优化效果。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents optimize the power, performance, and area (PPA) of register-transfer-level (RTL) designs by iterating over edits, synthesis, and PPA analysis, paying a dollar cost for every LLM call. Prior agents report the quality reached without its normalized cost, attribute that quality to an engineered cross-design memory, and hold the reasoning effort of every call fixed. We propose Ares with three corresponding innovations. (1) We introduce a normalized dollar cost per LLM call reported alongside the figure of merit (FoM), enabling fair comparison across effort levels and optimizers. (2) Using this accounting, we find the construction of the long-term memory matters little. An engineered memory brings no dependable gain over a plain concatenation of the same experience. (3) We instead adapt the per-call reasoning effort by escalating to deeper reasoning only once progress at a lower effort stalls, via a patience counter fit on 21 training designs, allocating reasoning where it pays rather than uniformly across all iterations. On three test designs unseen during training, the effort policy lowers the FoM by 23-27% where the best fixed effort reaches 16-23%, at equal normalized cost. Ares closes up to 83% of the gap from an LLM-drafted multiply-accumulate unit to its highly hand-optimized counterpart, and reaches a 25% deeper FoM than state-of-the-art Dr. RTL at 12% of its tokens.

</details>


### [303] [Demystifying DRAM Read Disturbance: Bridging the Gap Between Experimental Characterization and Device-Level Modeling of RowHammer and RowPress Phenomena](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28233)
*Haocong Luo,Longda Zhou,Ataberk Olgun,İsmail Emir Yüksel,Nisa Bostanci,Zhigang Ji,Xing Wu,Onur Mutlu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文旨在弥合DRAM读取干扰（RowHammer和RowPress）的实验表征与设备级物理模型之间的鸿沟，通过识别现有模型的不足之处，并进行全面的TCAD仿真来匹配真实芯片中的位翻转现象，从而提供更准确的设备级错误机制理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DRAM读取干扰（如RowHammer和RowPress）会导致非目标存储单元发生意外位翻转，严重威胁基于DRAM的计算系统的安全性、可靠性与稳定性。现有研究分为两类：一类基于实验表征提出缓解方案，但缺乏物理层面原理支撑；另一类研究设备级物理机制，但这些机制无法完全解释所有重要的实验观察结果。两者之间存在明显的gap，需要建立统一的理解框架。

Method: 1) 识别并演示现有设备级模型描述与实验表征之间在三个关键指标上的不一致：位翻转方向、位翻转次数、触发首次位翻转所需的最小激活次数（ACmin）；2) 开展全面且严格的TCAD仿真，匹配实验表征中观察到的RowHammer和RowPress位翻转现象；3) 通过仿真结果，总结更新的设备级错误机制，并识别影响仿真与真实芯片匹配度的关键建模和仿真参数。

Result: 论文提出了更新的设备级错误机制来解释RowHammer和RowPress位翻转，并识别出显著影响仿真结果与真实芯片表征匹配度的关键建模和仿真参数。基于这些发现，论文为DRAM读取干扰位翻转的实验表征方法论以及缓解技术的设计提供了相关启示。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了DRAM读取干扰实验表征与设备级建模之间的鸿沟，为未来在理解、表征和缓解DRAM读取干扰问题上提供了有原则的基础。通过TCAD仿真验证与关键参数识别，论文不仅深化了对RowHammer和RowPress物理机制的理解，还为更严谨高效的实验表征方法和更有效的缓解技术设计指明了方向。

Abstract: DRAM read disturbance, like RowHammer and RowPress, is a critical robustness issue where accessing DRAM can cause unintended bitflips in other unaccessed DRAM locations. DRAM read disturbance bitflips significantly impact the safe, secure, and reliable operation of DRAM-based computing systems. Many prior works experimentally characterize these bitflips and propose mitigations based on empirical results. Other device-level works study their underlying physical mechanisms, but these mechanisms do not fully explain all major empirical observations.
  Our goal is to bridge the gap between experimental characterization and device-level modeling and understanding of RowHammer and RowPress, providing a principled foundation for future work on understanding, characterizing, and mitigating DRAM read disturbance. We first identify and demonstrate gaps and inconsistencies between the physical mechanisms of RowHammer and RowPress described by existing device-level models and experimental characterization of their bitflips. We focus on three fundamental metrics that should map to first-order physical mechanisms: 1) bitflip directions, 2) bitflip counts, and 3) the minimum number of aggressor row activations that trigger the first bitflips (i.e., ACmin). Second, we present a comprehensive and rigorous set of TCAD simulations that match phenomena observed in experimental characterizations of RowHammer and RowPress bitflips.
  From our results, we 1) summarize updated device-level error mechanisms for understanding RowHammer and RowPress bitflips, and 2) identify key modeling and simulation parameters that significantly affect whether simulation results match real-chip characterization. We discuss implications for 1) rigorous, comprehensive, and efficient experimental characterization methodologies of DRAM read disturbance bitflips, and 2) the design of DRAM read disturbance mitigation techniques.

</details>


<div id='cs.CR'></div>

# cs.CR [[Back]](#toc)

### [304] [FAVA: Formal Authorization for Verified Agents with Evidence-Backed Permission Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27267)
*Yifan Zhang,Xinkui Zhao,Sai Liu,Hengxuan Lou,Guanjie Cheng,Chang Liu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: FAVA是一个面向LLM代理的形式化授权框架，通过权限中间表示（IR）将模糊的自然语言任务转换为结构化约束，再降级为证据支持的权限图谱，并利用SMT求解器对安全策略进行数学验证，在有效操作执行前完成授权或拦截。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理在动态环境中自主执行语义推理和复杂系统操作，静态的工具级权限无法满足安全需求，因为授权高度依赖上下文和不断变化的运行时状态与数据流。

Method: FAVA包含四个核心组件：（1）LLM引导的权限中间表示（Permission IR），将自然语言任务翻译为结构化约束；（2）确定性降级过程，将IR转换为带证据的权限图谱，显式跟踪数据流、依赖关系和上下文标签；（3）SMT求解器作为授权器，在执行任何有效操作前对当前图谱与安全策略进行数学验证；（4）运行时网关执行求解结果，授权执行或通过精确反例进行拦截。

Result: 在OpenAgentSafety、OctoBench和ActPlane场景中评估，FAVA在聚合数据集上达到90.5%的决策合规率（DCR），成功拦截评估的轨迹条件场景中的动态违规轨迹。

Conclusion: FAVA证明了将形式化方法（SMT求解）与LLM引导的授权机制相结合可以有效解决代理环境中动态、上下文敏感的权限安全问题，为LLM代理提供严格可验证的安全保证。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents autonomously interleave semantic reasoning with complex system operations. In these dynamic environments, static tool-level permissions are fundamentally insufficient; safe authorization is highly context-dependent and heavily reliant on evolving runtime states and data flows. We present FAVA (Formal Authorization for Verified Agents), a permission-carrying authorization framework for agent execution. FAVA utilizes an LLM-guided Permission Intermediate Representation (IR) to translate ambiguous natural-language tasks into structured constraints. A deterministic lowering pass then converts this IR into an evidence-backed permission graph that explicitly tracks data flows, dependencies, and contextual labels. To provide strict security guarantees, a Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) authorizer mathematically verifies the current graph against security policies before any effectful action executes. A runtime gateway then enforces the solver's result, either authorizing the execution or intercepting it with a precise counterexample. We evaluate FAVA across OpenAgentSafety, OctoBench, and ActPlane scenarios. Our evaluation demonstrates that FAVA achieves a 90.5% Decision Compliance Rate (DCR) over the aggregate dataset, successfully intercepting dynamic violating traces in the evaluated trace-conditioned scenarios.

</details>


### [305] [Open Security Benchmark: Towards Autonomous Enterprise Cyber Defense](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27288)
*Gal Engelberg,Michael Arenzon,Leon Goldberg*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文介绍开放安全基准(OSB)，一个用于端到端评估代理AI在企业自主网络防御中态势感知与调查能力的框架，它通过冻结的企业安全环境快照提供闭式ground truth，支持文本转SQL和原生API两种调查模态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业正转向自主网络防御，依赖代理AI对安全态势的持续感知与推理决策。然而，真实企业环境具有私有性、跨厂商性和深度关联性，无法作为公开可查询的共享目标用于端到端评估代理系统，这一"环境数据缺口"使得当前领域无法回答"代理是否值得被信任"这一核心问题。

Method: OSB框架由五个组件构成：数据层、任务与评估集层、多维评分层、最小可审计的测试平台，以及bring-your-own路径，用于在统一基底上支撑公开对比与私有租户评估。框架冻结企业环境为不可变快照，将答案锚定到闭式ground truth，并在同一环境的两种模态下评估态势调查：关系快照上的text-to-SQL和厂商原生API。

Result: 作者用两个身份安全包和一族合成组织环境数据集（覆盖多种规模）实例化该框架，并规划了向更多态势子域、调查模态以及从评估到修复的防御阶段的扩展方向。

Conclusion: OSB提供了一种可审计、可复现、跨厂商的代理AI评估基底，弥合了企业安全态势调查中公开基准缺失的空白，为建立可信自主网络防御系统奠定了基础。

Abstract: Enterprises are moving toward autonomous cyber defense: agentic AI that builds situational awareness of an organization's security state and reasons from it to assessments, decisions, and actions. This rests on a holistic view of the enterprise's security state, the continuous, cross-vendor picture of identities, cloud and infrastructure, data, applications, and their configurations that security posture management assembles. As agents take on this work, what matters is not whether an agent can produce an answer but whether it should be trusted to. The field cannot yet answer this question. Real enterprise environments are private, cross-vendor, and deeply correlated, and none is exposed publicly as a shared, queryable target for evaluating such agents end to end. We call this the environment data gap. We present Open Security Benchmark (OSB), a framework that benchmarks agentic AI on this work. OSB surfaces a curated enterprise environment - a frozen, holistic view of the security state - and evaluates posture investigation across two modalities: text-to-SQL over a relational snapshot and each vendor's native API over a served instance of the same environment. Freezing the environment pins the target state as an immutable snapshot and anchors answers to a closed-form ground truth. OSB is built from five components: a data layer, a task and evaluation-set layer, a multi-dimensional scoring layer, a minimal auditable harness, and a bring-your-own path that serves public comparison and private tenant evaluation from one substrate. We instantiate the framework with two identity-security packs and a family of synthetic-organization environment datasets spanning multiple scales, and chart its extension to further posture subdomains, investigation modalities, and defense stages from assessment toward remediation.

</details>


### [306] [RoguePrompt: Dual-Layer Encoding for Self-Reconstruction to Circumvent LLM Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27373)
*Benyamin Tafreshian,Prathamesh Dhake*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出RoguePrompt，一种通过Vigenere+ROT13双重嵌套编码对禁止提示词进行分区的越狱流水线，在黑盒威胁模型下对313个真实硬拒绝提示词进行测试，实现了93.93%的过滤绕过率、79.02%的重构率和70.18%的执行率，并提供了阶段级证据说明多阶段提示变换攻击在哪个环节失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型越狱攻击研究通常将过滤绕过、受限请求恢复和后续执行合并为单一的"攻击成功"指标，缺乏对多阶段提示变换攻击在黑盒交互中具体在哪个环节失败的细粒度证据，难以指导防御策略的针对性设计。

Method: RoguePrompt管道将禁止提示词进行分区，应用Vigenere和ROT13两层嵌套编码，并辅以自然语言重构指令。在仅拥有API或用户界面访问权限的黑盒威胁模型下开发与评估，分别以过滤绕过、指令重构和执行作为独立阶段衡量成功率。

Result: 在313个真实硬拒绝提示词上，RoguePrompt实现了平均93.93%的过滤绕过率、79.02%的重构率和70.18%的执行率，表明分层提示编码的有效性，同时揭示了多阶段越狱在各阶段的失败分布。

Conclusion: 分层提示编码（Vigenere+ROT13嵌套）是一种有效的越狱手段，阶段级评估方法能更清晰地揭示多阶段攻击的薄弱环节，为LLM安全防御提供更精确的改进方向。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly integrated into mainstream development platforms and daily technological workflows, typically behind moderation and safety controls. Despite these controls, preventing prompt-based policy evasion remains challenging, and adversaries continue to "jailbreak" LLMs by crafting prompts that circumvent implemented safety mechanisms. Prior work has established cipher-mediated interaction, code-embedded decryption, prompt decomposition and reconstruction, and layered custom encryption as viable attack primitives. However, reported evaluations generally collapse visible acceptance, successful recovery of the concealed request, and subsequent execution into an aggregate attack-success outcome. This leaves limited evidence about where multistage prompt-transformation attacks fail within an observable black-box interaction. This paper introduces RoguePrompt, a jailbreak pipeline that partitions a forbidden prompt and applies two nested encodings, Vigenere followed by ROT13, along with natural-language reconstruction instructions. RoguePrompt was developed and evaluated under a black-box threat model, with only API or user-interface access to the hosted models, and was tested on 313 real-world, hard-rejected prompts. Success was measured in terms of moderation bypass, instruction reconstruction, and execution when the relevant stage exceeded its automated criterion. RoguePrompt achieved average rates of 93.93% for filter bypass, 79.02% for reconstruction, and 70.18% for execution. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of layered prompt encoding while providing stage-level evidence of where multistage jailbreaks fail during moderation bypass, instruction reconstruction, and execution.

</details>


### [307] [Low-Latency Bootstrapping for CKKS using Roots of Unity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27401)
*Jean-Sebastien Coron,Robin Koestler*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出SPRU bootstrapping，一种新的CKKS同态加密方案bootstrap算法。与传统的通过多项式近似模q约简的方法不同，SPRU将模q的加法群直接嵌入复数单位根中，利用CKKS方案原生支持该运算。该方法大幅降低了bootstrap所需的乘法深度，从而可以使用更小的环维度并提升效率。在OpenFHE C++库中，对少量槽位的密文，SPRU实现了最高5倍的延迟降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始CKKS bootstrapping需要同态评估一个近似模q约简的多项式，这导致较高的乘法深度和计算开销。为了降低bootstrap的计算成本，作者希望找到一种更直接、更高效的方法来在CKKS方案中执行模约简运算。

Method: SPRU bootstrapping通过将模q的加法群直接嵌入复数单位根来表达模约简运算，由于这种嵌入可以在CKKS方案中原生评估，因此避免了传统方法中高次多项式近似的开销，显著降低了所需的乘法深度，并允许使用更小的环维度。

Result: 在OpenFHE C++库实现中，SPRU bootstrapping对具有少量槽位的密文实现了最高5倍的延迟降低。

Conclusion: SPRU bootstrapping通过在CKKS中直接嵌入模q加法群到单位根，提供了一种比传统多项式近似方法更高效的bootstrap方案，特别适用于槽位数量较少的场景。

Abstract: We introduce Sparse Roots of Unity (SPRU) bootstrapping, a new bootstrapping algorithm for the CKKS homomorphic encryption scheme for approximate arithmetic. The original CKKS bootstrapping method relies on homomorphically evaluating a polynomial that approximates modular reduction modulo q. In contrast, SPRU bootstrapping directly embeds the additive group modulo q into the complex roots of unity, which can be evaluated natively in the CKKS scheme. This approach significantly reduces the multiplicative depth required for bootstrapping, enabling the use of a smaller ring dimension and improving efficiency. In practice, using the OpenFHE C++ library, SPRU bootstrapping achieves up to a 5x reduction in latency when applied to ciphertexts with a small number of slots.

</details>


### [308] [Granite: A Modular Methodology for Foundational Verification of Hardware-Software Leakage Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27480)
*Stella Lau,Andres Erbsen,Adam Chlipala*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Granite提出了一种用于RTL处理器模块化验证的方法，同时证明功能正确性与信息不泄漏性（对照ISA契约）。其核心思想是通过"泄漏感知的精化"（leakage-aware refinement via determinism）实现追踪等价性，将周期级确定性规范机器作为统一框架，统一建立正确性与机密性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬件处理器（尤其是流水线RISC设计）的微架构实现可能通过时序侧信道泄漏秘密信息。已有工作往往只验证功能正确性，或将安全验证与功能验证分开处理，缺乏从ISA契约到微架构周期级执行的模块化、可组合的端到端验证框架。

Method: Granite的核心技术是泄漏感知的精化（leakage-aware refinement via determinism）：将机密性与正确性统一表述为相对于一族周期级确定性规范机器的追踪等价性。对于秘密无关的非确定性，通过用仅作用于公开数据的不可信确定性函数对规范进行存在性参数化来处理。子模块分别针对各自的泄漏感知规范进行证明，证明可以组合成整个设计的安全保证。此外，与经过认证的静态分析（识别密码学常数时间代码）组合，消除所有中间规范（包括ISA契约本身）的可信计算基。

Result: 对具有推测执行、精确中断和I/O的流水线RISC设计，证明了周期级时序仅由ISA泄漏契约中指定的可观测项决定；对于保持可观测项独立于秘密的程序（遵循密码学常数时间纪律），排除了通过已知和未知时序侧信道的信息泄漏。最终推导出单一Rocq定理，证明硬件加软件密码学实现的周期级机密性。

Conclusion: Granite是首个实现指令集级泄漏契约与微架构特定周期级执行（含线级观测）之间模块化、基础性连接的工作；通过消除中间规范的可信计算基，实现了硬件与软件密码学实现的端到端周期级机密性保证。

Abstract: Granite is a methodology for modular verification of both functional correctness and nonleakage of RTL processors against ISA contracts. We prove that the cycle-by-cycle timing of a pipelined RISC design--with speculation, precise interrupts, and I/O--is determined solely by observables specified in an ISA leakage contract. For programs that keep observables independent of secrets (i.e., following the cryptographic-constant-time discipline), this result rules out information leakage through known and unknown timing side channels.
  Granite's specifications only constrain functional correctness and information-flow dependencies: not how many cycles an instruction takes, at which instruction an interrupt is handled, or the exact latencies of submodules such as multipliers and memory. Granite's central technique is leakage-aware refinement via determinism, which establishes correctness and confidentiality together as trace equivalence with respect to a family of cycle-level, deterministic spec machines. Secret-independent nondeterminism is handled by existentially parameterizing specs with untrusted, deterministic functions acting only on public data. Submodules are proved against their own leakage-aware specs, and these proofs compose into the whole-design guarantee--which therefore holds over a space of secure implementations.
  We believe this work is the first to achieve modular and foundational connection between instruction-set-level leakage contracts and microarchitecture-specific cycle-by-cycle execution with wire-level observations. Our proofs compose with a certified static analysis that recognizes cryptographic-constant-time code to derive a single Rocq theorem about the cycle-by-cycle confidentiality of a hardware-and-software cryptographic implementation--eliminating every intermediate specification, including the ISA contract itself, from the trusted computing base.

</details>


### [309] [Secure Aggregation for Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning on Clinical EEG Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28191)
*Pouya Rajabi,Mohsen Toorani*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于临床EEG数据的隐私保护联邦学习框架，基于掩码安全聚合作为核心防护机制，结合图通信、阈值秘密共享、抗掉线聚合、更新裁剪、Bloom filter隐私保护记录链接模块和辅助公证人可验证性，支持半诚实和恶意两种聚合设置。在TUH EEG模拟跨机构医疗场景中评估，安全变体可隐藏个体更新，但恶意设置和一致性检查会带来额外开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习允许多机构协作训练共享模型而无需交换原始临床EEG数据，但个体模型更新仍可能泄露隐私信息，现有联邦学习框架无法完全防止此类隐私泄露，需要更强的隐私保护机制。

Method: 以掩码(masking)安全聚合为核心，集成图通信、阈值秘密共享、抗掉线聚合、局部更新裁剪、可选的Bloom filter隐私保护记录链接初始化模块及辅助公证人可验证性，基于Flower联邦学习框架实现，支持半诚实和恶意两种聚合设置。

Result: 在TUH EEG数据的模拟跨医疗机构场景中，安全变体能在既定假设下向聚合服务器隐藏个体更新，与联邦模型训练兼容。半诚实变体开销最低；恶意设置和辅助公证人变体提供更强的一致性、完整性和轻量级验证支持，但引入更高的计算、通信和轮次时长开销。

Conclusion: 所提出的隐私保护联邦学习框架在保护临床EEG数据隐私的同时保持可训练性，半诚实变体适合低开销场景，恶意和公证人变体适合对安全性和可验证性要求更高的场景，用户需根据需求在隐私保护强度与性能开销之间权衡。

Abstract: Federated learning enables multiple institutions to train shared models without exchanging raw clinical EEG data, but it does not fully prevent privacy leakage from individual model updates. This paper presents a privacy-preserving federated learning framework for clinical EEG data using masking-based secure aggregation as the core protection mechanism. The framework combines graph-based communication, threshold secret sharing, dropout-resilient aggregation, local update clipping, an optional Bloom filter-based privacy-preserving record-linkage initialization module, and auxiliary-notary-based verifiability. It supports both semi-honest and malicious aggregation settings and is implemented using the Flower federated learning framework. The secure-aggregation variants are evaluated in a simulated cross-silo healthcare setting using TUH EEG-derived data under different client configurations. Under the stated assumptions, the secure variants hide individual updates from the aggregation server. The results show that these variants remain compatible with federated model training, although malicious-setting safeguards and lightweight consistency-checking mechanisms introduce additional computation, communication, and round-duration overhead. The semi-honest variant provides the lowest overhead among the secure configurations, while malicious and auxiliary-notary variants offer stronger consistency, integrity, and lightweight verification support at higher cost.

</details>


### [310] [Flock: Fast Proving for Batch Boolean Computations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27491)
*Benedikt Bünz,Ron D. Rothblum,William Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Flock是一种基于哈希的SNARK系统，专门用于大规模批量布尔计算的极速证明，如SHA-256、Keccak和BLAKE3哈希评估。通过结合lincheck和zerocheck协议的新优化以及由编码智能体协同设计的激进优化实现，Flock在M4 Max单核上每秒可证明8.2万次BLAKE3压缩函数、4.2万次SHA-256压缩和3万次Keccak置换，开销仅为原生执行的250倍以下；在十核上吞吐量超过66万次BLAKE3压缩/秒，比Binius64快9倍以上，比最快的椭圆曲线SNARK快500倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNARK应用中验证大量标准密码学哈希（如SHA-256、Keccak、BLAKE3）的批量评估是关键瓶颈，需要一种能极速证明此类批量布尔计算的SNARK方案。

Method: Flock通过组合lincheck和zerocheck协议的新优化，并利用编码智能体协同设计的激进优化实现，证明相同R1CS电路（含输入输出关系）的批次，支持哈希链、Merkle路径打开，并原则上可扩展至完整的基于哈希的签名验证。

Result: 在M4 Max单核上，Flock每秒可证明8.2万次BLAKE3压缩函数、4.2万次SHA-256压缩和3万次Keccak置换，开销低于原生执行的250倍。十核时吞吐量超过66万次BLAKE3压缩/秒，SHA-256证明速度比Binius64快9倍以上，比最快的椭圆曲线SNARK快500倍以上。

Conclusion: Flock在批量哈希计算的SNARK证明方面实现了显著的性能突破，大幅超越现有方案的证明速度，为依赖批量哈希验证的应用提供了高效的解决方案。

Abstract: For many applications of SNARKs, a key bottleneck is proving large batches of standard cryptographic hash evaluations, such as SHA-256, Keccak, or BLAKE3. We introduce Flock, a hash-based SNARK for extremely fast proving of such batched Boolean computations. Flock proves batches of the same R1CS circuit (plus input/output relations between them), can prove hash-chains and Merkle path openings, and in principle can be extended to full-fledged hash-based signature verification. At its core, Flock combines new optimizations for the lincheck and zerocheck protocols with an aggressively optimized proof-of-concept implementation co-designed by coding agents.
  On a single core of an M4 Max processor, Flock proves 82k evaluations of the BLAKE3 compression function, 42k SHA-256 compressions, and 30k Keccak permutations per second --- less than a $250\times$ overhead over native execution. On ten cores, throughput exceeds 660k BLAKE3 compressions per second; in proving SHA-256, Flock is more than $9\times$ faster than Binius64, the prior state of the art, and more than $500\times$ faster than the fastest elliptic curve-based SNARK we measured against.

</details>


### [311] [Send and Pretend: Exploiting Transcript Consistency Issues in End-to-End Encrypted Group Chats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27510)
*Gabriel K. Gegenhuber,Moritz Grefner,Maximilian Günther,Matthäus Wininger,David Schmidt,Aljosha Judmayer*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文系统性地证明了当今主流端到端加密（E2EE）即时通讯应用（如Signal、iMessage、WhatsApp、Threema）在群聊中均无法保证"转录一致性"（Transcript Consistency, TC），即恶意群成员可对不同接收者选择性省略、重排或篡改内容而不触发任何用户界面警告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: E2EE消息应用因其安全性而被广泛用于群聊中的敏感协调（如政治决策）。近期Signal和iMessage也引入了投票功能，这隐式要求所有参与者看到相同的结果和对话视图（即转录一致性）。然而此前研究并未系统性地验证这些应用是否真正满足这一基本安全属性。

Method: 作者在恶意参与者威胁模型下，系统性地调查了主流E2EE群聊协议。他们识别出多种"多义向量"（equivocation vectors），包括协议回退路径、群内故意使用点对点投递通道等，并演示了具体的攻击场景（社会工程、逃避审核、操纵投票），同时揭示了与隐私相关的实现特有行为（如设备OS指纹识别）。

Result: 发现所有被调查的主流E2EE即时通讯应用在群聊中均不保证任何形式的转录一致性；恶意群成员可以对不同接收者提供不一致的对话内容而不触发警告。研究还发现了跨服务的设计缺陷以及实现层面的隐私泄露问题。

Conclusion: 作者将发现置于先前转录一致性研究的背景下，并提出了低开销的缓解措施和UI信号策略，可集成到当前最先进的E2EE群组协议中以改善安全性。

Abstract: End-to-end encrypted (E2EE) messaging apps are widely praised for their security and thus also used for sensitive coordination in group chats (e.g., by political decision makers). After Threema and WhatsApp, also Signal and iMessage have recently introduced polls to aid agreement processes in groups. This implicitly sets the expectation that all participants see the same outcome and thus have the same view of the conversation. This property is commonly referred to as transcript consistency (TC). In this work, we demonstrate that today's major E2EE messengers do not guarantee any form of TC for group chats, allowing a malicious group member to selectively omit, reorder, or present altered content to different recipients without triggering warnings in their user interface. We systematically investigate the extent of the problem under a malicious-participant threat model that targets the integrity of the shared transcript, or inconsistent delivery across a user's linked devices. We identify multiple equivocation vectors that range from protocol fallback paths to deliberate use of pairwise delivery channels within groups. We demonstrate concrete exploitation scenarios such as social engineering, evading moderation, and, in particular, rigging polls. Beyond these cross-service design issues, we also uncover implementation-specific behaviors with privacy implications (e.g., device OS fingerprinting). Finally, we contextualize our findings within prior transcript-consistency research and outline practical low-overhead mitigations and UI signaling strategies that can be integrated into state-of-the-art E2EE group protocols.

</details>


### [312] [ThreatForest: Multi-Agent Attack Tree Generation with Pluggable TTP Framework Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27528)
*Cristian Leo,Anton Dykyi,Danny Cortegaca,Daniel Begimher,Prakash Jha*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: ThreatForest是一个多智能体系统，能够从源代码仓库自动生成结构化的攻击树，将攻击步骤映射到TTP框架（MITRE ATT&CK、CAPEC等），并合成可操作的缓解措施。系统采用多阶段流水线架构（含确定性验证门、有界重试和人工介入点），并通过领域特定的sentence-transformer进行TTP映射。实验发现嵌入阶段是系统准确性的主导瓶颈（TTP映射仅0.29分），而非多智能体流水线本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云原生架构的手动威胁建模速度慢且依赖稀缺的安全专家，需要自动化方法来加速和扩展威胁建模过程，使其能够从源代码仓库直接生成结构化的安全分析结果。

Method: 提出ThreatForest多智能体系统，将威胁建模分解为多阶段代理流水线（仓库分析、上下文精炼、威胁生成、并行攻击树构建+TT映射+缓解合成、报告生成），以有向图编排，含确定性验证门、有界重试和三个人工介入验证点。使用领域特定的sentence-transformer通过余弦相似度将攻击步骤映射到候选技术，并在七个应用领域上使用十六维评分标准由独立LLM评审员（含对抗验证和专家审查）进行评估。

Result: 威胁陈述、攻击树和缓解措施的质量达到0.63-0.68（0-1分制），但嵌入层TTP映射仅0.29分，七个领域表现一致。单次调用基线在相同模型上的映射可辩护性提升了2倍多，证明瓶颈在嵌入编码器而非多智能体设计。

Conclusion: ThreatForest是首个将代码仓库转化为跨对抗框架的TTP映射攻击树和基于证据的缓解措施的端到端系统，并提供了一个可复用的基准测试框架，其关键发现是嵌入层是当前系统精度提升的主要瓶颈。

Abstract: Threat modeling is essential for secure software development, yet manual analysis of cloud-native architectures is slow and demands scarce security expertise. We present ThreatForest, a multi-agent system that generates structured attack trees from source code repositories, maps attack steps to adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) from a pluggable set of frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, CAPEC, and cloud-specific threat matrices), and synthesizes actionable mitigations. ThreatForest decomposes threat modeling into a multi-stage agent pipeline -- repository analysis, context refinement, threat generation, parallel attack-tree construction with TTP mapping and mitigation synthesis, and report generation -- orchestrated as a directed graph with deterministic verification gates, bounded retries, and three human-in-the-loop validation points. A domain-specific sentence-transformer maps each attack step to candidate techniques by cosine similarity; we show empirically that this embedding stage, not the surrounding pipeline, is the dominant accuracy bottleneck. We evaluate ThreatForest across seven application domains on a sixteen-dimension rubric, scored by a panel of independent LLM raters with an adversarial verification pass and expert review. Panel-measured quality reaches 0.63-0.68 (on a 0-1 scale) for threat statements, attack trees, and mitigations, but only 0.29 for embedding-only TTP mapping -- a gap stable across all seven domains that isolates the binding constraint. A controlled single-call baseline on the same model more than doubles mapping defensibility, pinning the limitation on the embedding encoder rather than the multi-agent design. To our knowledge, ThreatForest is the first end-to-end system that turns a code repository into TTP-mapped attack trees with evidence-based mitigations across adversary frameworks, with a reusable framework for benchmarking such systems.

</details>


### [313] [AnchorMark: Robust Diffusion Watermarking via Latent-Space Rotation Synchrony](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27551)
*Yuqi Qian,Yun Cao,Haocheng Fu,Haochen Zhao,Hong Zhang,Meineng Zhu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出AnchorMark，一个无需训练、基于反演的鲁棒水印方法。它利用发现的"旋转同步性"潜在属性（图像域旋转与恢复的初始潜空间中对应物角度一致），在初始潜空间的中心区域嵌入同步锚点，从而在提取时准确估计并校正旋转角度，显著提升在旋转及组合攻击下的位准确率，同时几乎不影响图像质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于反演（inversion-based）的水印方法在复合有损后处理下仍然脆弱，尤其是涉及旋转时，旋转会破坏潜空间解码所需的空间对应关系，导致水印提取失败。

Method: 1) 揭示潜在属性"旋转同步性"（Rotation Synchrony）：图像域旋转与恢复的初始潜空间中的对应旋转具有相同角度。2) 基于此属性，在初始潜空间的中心区域嵌入同步锚点（synchronization anchor），用于在提取过程中准确估计并校正旋转角度。

Result: 实验表明，AnchorMark在旋转攻击和组合攻击下大幅提高了位准确率（bit accuracy），同时对图像质量的影响有限。

Conclusion: AnchorMark通过利用旋转同步性属性并嵌入同步锚点，有效克服了基于反演水印在旋转及组合攻击下的脆弱性，实现了无需训练的鲁棒水印方案。

Abstract: Inversion-based watermarking embeds watermark payloads directly into the generative process, avoiding a separate post-hoc image-domain embedding stage while preserving the native visual fidelity of synthesized images. However, existing methods remain vulnerable to compound lossy post-processing, particularly when rotation is involved, as it disrupts the spatial correspondence required for latent-space decoding. To overcome this limitation, we introduce AnchorMark, a training-free, robust inversion-based watermarking. We uncover a latent-space property termed Rotation Synchrony: image-domain rotations and their counterparts in the recovered initial latent share the same angle. Building on this property, AnchorMark embeds a synchronization anchor in the central region of the initial latent, enabling accurate estimation and correction of the rotation angle during extraction. Experiments show that AnchorMark substantially improves bit accuracy under rotation and combined attacks, with limited impact on image quality.

</details>


### [314] [Revisiting the Adversarial Robustness of Graph-Based Traffic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27604)
*Qingzhao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了基于图的交通预测AI模型的鲁棒性研究，指出以往攻击和防御都建立在不切实际的威胁模型上。作者提出了一种物理感知的目标定位攻击，并引入基于物理信息的学习型检测器作为防御机制，在15个模型-数据集设置中的13个上优于对抗训练，且对干净数据几乎无损耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往关于交通预测AI的鲁棒性研究大多采用不切实际的威胁模型和未指定目标的攻击目标，导致攻击与防御的设计都偏离实际应用场景。实际中的攻击者通常仅有有限的模型知识，且只能监控和操控少数道路传感器，攻击往往被定位到特定路段或路线。这种针对性的攻击场景尚未被充分探索，而对抗训练等防御手段从范数有界攻击迁移到物理感知的结构化攻击时效果不佳。

Method: 作者将鲁棒性重构为检测问题：1)设计了一种物理感知的攻击，能够模拟真实拥堵模式并将误差集中在目标路段；2)训练了一个物理信息驱动的学习型检测器，其输出作为输入特征馈送给已加固的预测器；3)在预测器固定的情况下，针对自适应攻击进行联合训练。评估涵盖多种模型架构和基准数据集。

Result: 物理感知攻击使目标链接误差成倍增加，而全网误差几乎不动；针对范数有界扰动调优的对抗训练几乎无法抵御该攻击。所提出的检测-缓解防御在15个模型-数据集设置中的13个上优于针对物理感知攻击本身进行对抗训练的模型，在留出攻击上差距最大，且干净数据上代价接近零。

Conclusion: 研究强调，在评估AI对抗攻击的真实安全影响时，必须在应用特定的约束下审视抽象的攻击模型。将鲁棒性视为检测问题并引入物理感知的检测-缓解框架，是在实际交通场景中比传统对抗训练更有效且更实用的防御策略。

Abstract: Traffic forecasting by graph-based AI is a critical component of intelligent transportation systems, motivating security research on robustness to malicious sensor readings. We argue that prior robustness evaluations are largely shaped by unrealistic threat models and untargeted objectives, so both attacks and defenses must be revisited. We study a practical adversary with limited model knowledge and the ability to monitor and manipulate only a few road sensors. More importantly, practical attacks can be localized to specific links or routes, causing incorrect estimated arrival times or unnecessary rerouting while leaving the broader network largely unaffected. This targeted setting remains underexplored, and defenses such as adversarial training do not transfer well from the norm-bounded attacks they train on to structurally different, physics-aware attacks that mimic genuine congestion. We therefore reframe robustness as a detection problem, introducing a learned physics-informed detector whose output is fed to a hardened forecaster as an input feature and trained against adaptive attacks with the forecaster fixed. We evaluate across a variety of model architectures and benchmarks. The physics-aware attack multiplies target-link error several-fold while the network-wide error barely moves, and adversarial training, tuned to norm-bounded perturbations, barely dents it. Our detection--mitigation defense improves even on adversarial training hardened against the physics-aware attack itself, on $13$ of $15$ model--dataset settings and by the widest margin on a held-out attack, at near-zero clean cost. The results emphasize the need to examine abstracted AI adversarial attacks under application-specific constraints to assess their true security impacts.

</details>


### [315] [Strategy Phasing of Cyber Attacks on Digital Substations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27661)
*Akila Herath,Chen-Ching Liu,Junho Hong,Kuchan Park*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出SubCASP方法，基于隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）融合IDS数据日志，推断IEC 61850数字变电站网络攻击的当前阶段、下一阶段和回溯攻击路径，以克服现有IDS仅孤立标记症状而缺乏攻击阶段上下文的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IEC 61850数字变电站提高了电力系统运行效率，但攻击者可滥用其通信协议操纵断路器操作造成严重影响。此类网络攻击基于多阶段策略实施，而现有入侵检测系统（IDS）仅标记孤立症状，缺乏攻击阶段的上下文信息，难以支持缓解措施的部署。

Method: SubCASP基于隐马尔可夫模型（HMM），融合IDS数据日志以推断攻击阶段。攻击阶段从ATT&CK威胁建模中推导得出。模型在可复现的攻击图数据集上进行训练和评估。

Result: 测试结果表明SubCASP在不同IDS可观测性水平和缺失IDS数据日志场景下均表现出鲁棒性。

Conclusion: SubCASP能够有效推断当前攻击阶段、预测下一步攻击并重构历史攻击路径，为变电站多阶段网络攻击提供阶段级上下文感知，从而支持缓解措施的及时部署。

Abstract: Digital substations that comply with IEC 61850 have improved the operational efficiency of modern power systems. However, adversaries can abuse IEC 61850 communication to manipulate circuit breaker operations in substations, which can result in severe system impacts. These cyber attacks are crafted based on broader multi-phase strategies. The existing intrusion detection systems (IDSs) often flag only isolated symptoms. Thus, there is a lack of context in the attack phase to support the deployment of mitigation measures. This paper proposes Substation Cyber Attack Strategy Phasing (SubCASP), a Hidden Markov Model(HMM)- based method that fuses IDS data logs to infer the current attack phase, next attack phase, and retrospective attack path. The attack phases are derived from an ATT&CK-based threat modeling. The SubCASP model is trained and evaluated on a reproducible attack-graph dataset. Test results are presented to demonstrate the robustness of SubCASP for various IDS observability levels and missing IDS data logs scenarios.

</details>


### [316] [Distributed Point Functions and Function Secret Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27696)
*Elette Boyle,Niv Gilboa,Yuval Ishai,Peter Scholl*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文综述了分布式点函数（DPF）的定义、构造和应用，并讨论了其向函数秘密共享（FSS）的扩展，FSS将点函数泛化以支持更丰富的函数类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPF作为一种密码学原语，因其轻量级结构而支持多种应用（如私有信息检索、匿名消息传递、预处理安全计算及伪随机相关生成器），因此有必要对其定义、构造和应用进行系统性的综述，并探讨其扩展方向FSS。

Method: 本文采用综述方法，系统梳理了DPF的定义、构造方案及其应用场景，并讨论DPF向FSS的泛化扩展。FSS将点函数推广到更丰富的函数类，高效的FSS方案能够为DPF的大多数应用提供类似的泛化支持。

Result: 文章完成了对DPF定义的梳理、构造方案的分类总结以及应用场景的全面回顾，并展示了DPF如何扩展至FSS以支持更广泛的函数类，使大多数DPF应用能够受益于这种泛化。

Conclusion: DPF在多方计算与密码学应用中具有广泛价值，而FSS作为其推广形式，为更丰富的函数类提供了高效的秘密共享方案，从而拓展了相关应用的范围和灵活性。

Abstract: A distributed point function (DPF) is a cryptographic primitive that enables compressed additive sharing of a secret weight-1 vector (equivalently, a point function) across two or more parties. The appealing lightweight structure of DPF constructions has enabled a wide range of applications. These include private information retrieval, anonymous messaging, secure computation with preprocessing, and pseudorandom correlation generators for expanding small correlated seeds into large pseudorandom instances of cryptographic correlations.
  In this article, we survey definitions, constructions, and applications of DPFs. We also discuss the extension of DPF to function secret sharing (FSS), which generalizes point functions to support richer function classes. Efficient FSS schemes yield a similar generalization for most of the applications of DPFs.

</details>


### [317] [CHARGE: Leveraging CWE Hierarchies for Hardware Security SystemVerilog Assertion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27776)
*Xiao Tan,Cynthia Sturton*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出了CHARGE框架，利用CWE层次结构和大型语言模型自动为未验证的RTL模块生成安全属性，在Hack@DAC18/19/21 SoC设计上检测出27/42个已知bug，并在Hack@DAC21中发现了一个新bug。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统安全属性生成依赖可信设计规格说明且需要大量人工工程投入，而现有方法在缺乏规格说明的情况下难以准确识别未验证RTL模块中的安全关键资产和推断预期安全行为。

Method: 利用CWE条目的层次结构特性作为推理过程的基础，通过大语言模型识别RTL模块中的安全关键资产，从识别出的资产和CWE语义中推断预期安全行为并生成安全属性（SVA），避免依赖可信设计规格。

Result: 在Hack@DAC18、19和21的开源SoC设计上使用GPT-4.1进行评估，检测出42个已知bug中的27个。在Hack@DAC21 OpenPiton SoC上，89%生成的SVA在Cadence JasperGold FPV中可运行，92.2%非空泛。相比手工编写属性，CHARGE正确生成了三个手工属性出错bug的属性，并发现了一个此前未被识别的新bug。

Conclusion: CHARGE通过结合CWE层次语义和LLM推理，能够在不依赖可信设计规格的情况下自动生成高质量的安全属性，既提高了安全验证的覆盖率，又发现了新的安全漏洞，验证了该方法的有效性和实用性。

Abstract: This paper presents CHARGE, an automated framework for generating security properties for unverified RTL modules using CWEs and large language models (LLMs). The hallmark is a reasoning process that leverages the hierarchical nature of CWE entries to improve accuracy when identifying security-critical assets in unverified RTL modules. As a result, the approach can infer expected security behaviors and generate properties from identified assets and CWE semantics, avoiding the need for trusted design specifications and reducing manual engineering effort. We evaluate the framework on the Hack@DAC18, 19, and 21 open source SoC designs using OpenAI's GPT-4.1. CHARGE detects 27 of 42 known bugs in these designs. For Hack@DAC21 OpenPiton SoC, 89% of the generated SVAs run in Cadence JasperGold FPV, and 92.2% are non-vacuous. We compare to an open-source, manually written set of properties for these designs and find that CHARGE correctly writes properties for three bugs in which the manually written properties were incorrect. In addition, CHARGE-generated properties identify a new bug in the Hack@DAC21 OpenPiton SoC that was not previously identified.

</details>


### [318] [Adaptive Security at the Edge for 6G-Enabled Healthcare IoT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27858)
*Ijaz Ahmad,Ijaz Ahmad,Erkki Harjula*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出NANOEDGEGUARD，一个在边缘网关内核平面运行的闭环速率控制器，通过自适应多级速率策略和滞回恢复机制，减轻医疗物联网突发流量对紧急报警延迟的影响，并在Raspberry Pi + MQTT + ESP32实验平台上验证了其对99分位报警RTT和突发流量接纳的改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗物联网服务依赖边缘网关转发常规遥测数据和紧急报警，但突发流量会显著恶化最坏情况延迟并干扰紧急消息传递。现有静态防火墙规则或用户空间控制环路的响应速度不足以应对此类突发场景，亟需更快、可审计且具备恢复能力的速率控制机制。

Method: NANOEDGEGUARD采用内核平面（kernel-plane）闭环控制器架构，在边缘网关处观测每个数据源（per-source）的流量强度，利用内核流量控制钩子（in-kernel traffic-control hooks）执行可审计的多级速率策略。与静态防火墙规则或用户空间控制环不同，该设计强调通过滞回（hysteresis）机制实现快速执行和显式恢复，并记录策略转换日志以保证可审计性。

Result: 在Raspberry Pi网关（托管MQTT broker）和两个ESP32端点（生成生命体征、报警及定时突发流量）的实验环境中，自适应内核平面速率控制相比用户空间防火墙基线，将99分位报警RTT降低了13.3%，同时保持无强制策略时的RTT水平；相比无强制策略，将额外接纳的突发流量减少了46%。

Conclusion: 早期结果表明，在网关处进行自适应、可审计的强制控制能够提升医疗物联网的韧性，该机制未来可扩展至边缘智能场景中的按需策略部署。

Abstract: Healthcare IoT services increasingly rely on edge gateways to relay routine telemetry and deliver rare but timecritical alarms. Even short traffic bursts can inflate worstcase delay and interfere with urgent messages. We present NANOEDGEGUARD, a kernel-plane closed-loop controller that observes per-source traffic intensity at the edge and enforces an auditable, multi-tier rate policy using in-kernel traffic-control hooks. Unlike static firewall rules or user-space control loops, our design prioritizes fast actuation and explicit recovery through hysteresis, and it records policy transitions for auditability. Using a Raspberry Pi gateway hosting an MQTT broker and two ESP32 endpoints generating vitals, alarms, and a timed burst, we show that adaptive kernel-plane rate control reduces the 99th-percentile alarm RTT by 13.3% compared to a user-space firewall baseline while maintaining no-enforcement-level RTT, and it reduces excess admitted burst traffic by 46% compared to no enforcement. These early results indicate that adaptive, auditable enforcement at the gateway can improve resilience for healthcare IoT, and it can be extended toward on-demand policy deployment in future edge intelligence.

</details>


### [319] [Don't Trust the AI Ecosystem: Analyzing Privacy Leakage in Compromised Open-Source Components](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27886)
*Jin-Seong Kim,Han-Ju Lee,Seok-Won Hong,Takeshi Takahashi,Chansu Han,Tomohiro Morikawa,Seok-Hwan Choi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出GradLock，一种训练时注入攻击方法，通过在模型参数中直接注入敏感训练数据，利用无状态确定性索引建立孤立数据保险库，并通过动态梯度锁定防止有效载荷退化，从而在不需要保留训练环境访问权限的情况下，从最终模型中提取像素级完美的私有数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的模型反演（MI）攻击主要依赖训练后优化从模型输出中恢复私有数据，但受限于目标模型的泛化瓶颈，往往只能生成通用特征而非特定身份，尤其是在高维数据集上效果不佳。作者希望探索一种训练时注入的攻击途径，绕过这一根本性限制。

Method: GradLock采用两种核心技术：(1) 无状态确定性索引（stateless deterministic indexing）——在模型参数中建立孤立的"数据保险库"（data vaults），使攻击者无需训练环境即可定位注入数据；(2) 动态梯度锁定（dynamic gradient locking）——在优化过程中防止注入的有效载荷（payload）因梯度更新而退化或丢失。攻击发生在供应链受威胁的上下文中，即在模型训练阶段注入敏感数据。

Result: 在MNIST、Imagenette和CelebA数据集上的实验表明，GradLock实现了近无损重建（SSIM约1.0）和即时提取（<1.0秒）。与现有训练时注入方法相比，GradLock对量化、剪枝和微调等标准部署优化具有更强的鲁棒性。用户部署研究显示93.3%的参与者未能检测到恶意逻辑。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了现代AI供应链安全中的一个严重盲区：训练时注入攻击可以以极高的隐蔽性和鲁棒性窃取私有数据，且极少被用户或部署者察觉。这项工作强调了需要重新审视AI供应链各环节的安全保障措施。

Abstract: Existing model inversion (MI) attacks predominantly rely on post-training optimization to recover private data from model outputs. However, these methods are fundamentally constrained by the target model's generalization bottleneck, often yielding generic features rather than specific identities, particularly on high-dimensional datasets. In this paper, we introduce GradLock, a novel training-time injection attack that stealthily injects sensitive training data directly into the model parameters. Operating within a compromised supply chain context, GradLock leverages stateless deterministic indexing to establish isolated data vaults and employs dynamic gradient locking to prevent payload degradation during the optimization process. This mechanism allows the adversary to extract pixel-perfect data from the final model without retaining access to the training environment. Extensive experiments on MNIST, Imagenette, and CelebA demonstrate that GradLock achieves near-lossless reconstruction (SSIM ~ 1.0) and instant extraction (< 1.0s). Compared to existing training-time injection methods, our approach exhibits superior robustness against standard deployment optimizations, including quantization, pruning, and fine-tuning. Furthermore, a user deployment study reveals that 93.3% of participants failed to detect the malicious logic, highlighting a severe blind spot in the security of modern AI supply chains.

</details>


### [320] [Benign on Label, Malicious by Design: Clean-Label Dormant-to-Activated Backdoor via Machine Unlearning with Removable Camouflage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27936)
*Dongdong Zhao,Can Li,Xiang Yao,Fan He,Qihang Ge,Baogang Song*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于双生成器学习的干净标签"非学习激活型休眠后门"框架，通过双层优化同时建立持久潜在关联与可移除抑制影响，实现训练后休眠、机器非学习（unlearning）后激活的后门攻击，在CIFAR-10和ImageNet-10上验证了低攻击前成功率和强激活效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后门攻击在植入后立即生效，容易被检测暴露。尽管已有利用机器非学习激活的休眠后门方法，但难以在干净标签约束和现实非学习请求下同时实现低非学习前攻击成功率与强非学习后激活效果，关键在于需要同时建立持久潜在关联与可移除的抑制影响。

Method: 提出干净标签非学习激活后门框架，基于双生成器学习，将问题建模为双层优化：上层模拟潜在后门建立与机器非学习过程，交替学习样本特定触发器（建立触发-目标潜在关联）和标签一致的伪装样本（提供可移除的抑制）；当小部分伪装样本被非学习移除后，抑制解除，休眠后门被激活。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet-10上的实验表明，该方法在多种非学习算法下相比代表性后门基线，保持了更低的非学习前攻击成功率，同时实现了更强的非学习后激活效果。

Conclusion: 实验结果证明，通过协调持久潜在关联与可移除抑制，在干净标签和现实删除约束下可以实现可靠的休眠-激活转换，为后门攻击的隐蔽性与可控性提供了新范式。

Abstract: Existing backdoor attacks often become effective immediately after backdoor implantation and may therefore be exposed before exploitation. Machine unlearning activated dormant backdoors mitigate such behavioral exposure by remaining inactive after training and becoming effective only after selected training records are unlearned. However, existing methods struggle to simultaneously achieve a low pre-unlearning attack success rate and strong post-unlearning activation under clean-label constraints and realistic unlearning requests. Achieving this transition requires jointly establishing a persistent latent association and a removable suppressive influence. To address this challenge, we propose a clean-label unlearning-activated backdoor framework based on dual-generator learning and formulate it as a bilevel optimization problem: By simulating latent backdoor establishment and machine unlearning, the framework alternately learns sample-specific triggers that establish a latent trigger-to-target association and label-consistent camouflage samples that provide removable suppression. Once a small subset of camouflage samples is unlearned, the suppression is lifted and the dormant backdoor is activated. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-10 show that our method maintains lower pre-unlearning attack success rates while achieving stronger post-unlearning activation across multiple unlearning algorithms than representative backdoor baselines. These results demonstrate that reliable dormancy-to-activation transitions can be achieved by coordinating a persistent latent association with removable suppression under clean-label and realistic deletion constraints.

</details>


### [321] [Safeguards Based on Copyable Context Cannot Provide Reliable Safety for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27951)
*Pingyu Wu,Lingyao Zhu,Weiming Zhang,Nenghai Yu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文识别了大型语言模型安全防护中的一个基本困境：模型在回答前不知道答案的用途，导致双重用途任务中无法区分善意专业人员和攻击者。作者将模型释放的能力与下游使用的证据分离，推导出攻击者获得协助的最坏条件下的数学下限，并提出安全性三难困境（有用的能力、可靠的安全性、开放访问三者不可兼得），随后展示了可信凭证如何通过增加难以复制的信息来补充现有防护措施，并指出了消除该下限所需的更强条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型的安全防护系统在回答之前无法预见答案将被如何使用，这在双重用途任务（dual-use tasks）中造成了根本性问题：相同的答案既能帮助授权专业人士，也能帮助攻击者，而攻击者可以模仿善意请求和交互历史。现有防护措施无法从根本上解决这一信息不对称问题。

Method: 作者将模型释放的能力（capability）与关于下游使用的证据（evidence）进行分离分析。当证据可复制时，推导出攻击者获得协助的最坏情况下的精确下限（exact worst-case floor）。在此基础上，提出利用可信凭证（trusted credential）引入难以复制的信息来预测实际下游使用，并确定了消除该下限所需的更强条件。论文结合双重用途评估、自适应攻击和已部署的可信访问项目来验证这些条件的实际相关性。

Result: 推導出一個基本的三難困境：有用能力、可靠安全性與開放訪問三者不可兼顧。可複製證據情境下存在攻擊者協助的數學下限，無論模型多謹慎都無法消除。可信憑證作為補充機制可降低此下限，但需要更強的條件（超出簡單身份驗證）才能完全消除。

Conclusion: 大型語言模型的安全防護不能僅依賴回答前的判斷。要使雙重用途任務既安全又有用，需要引入難以複製的證據機制（如可信憑證），並接受「可用能力、可靠安全、開放訪問」之間存在根本性取捨的現實。這為防護系統的設計提供了理論框架和實踐方向。

Abstract: Large language model safeguards decide whether to answer before seeing how an answer will be used. This creates a basic problem for dual-use tasks: the same answer can help an authorized professional or an attacker, while an attacker can imitate a benign request and interaction history. We separate the capability released by the model from the evidence available about downstream use. When that evidence is copyable, we derive the exact worst-case floor on attacker assistance while preserving useful answers. The result yields a safety trilemma: Useful Capability, Reliable Safety, and Open Access cannot coexist. We then show how a trusted credential can complement existing safeguards by adding hard-to-copy information that predicts actual downstream use, and identify the stronger condition needed to eliminate the floor. Evidence from dual-use evaluations, adaptive attacks, and deployed trusted-access programs supports the practical relevance of these conditions.

</details>


### [322] [Driving up Inference Energy on SNNs: Per-Sample and Universal Sponge Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27990)
*Spyridon Raptis,Haralampos-G. Stratigopoulos*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次将海绵攻击（sponge attack）扩展到原生事件驱动的二进制输入的脉冲神经网络（SNN）上。作者提出了两种攻击模型：基于梯度优化的逐样本海绵攻击（使SynOps增加1.5-2.6倍，且在98%以上样本上保持预测类别不变），以及首个针对原生事件驱动SNN输入的通用海绵攻击（通过XOR施加固定二进制扰动，SynOps增加1.09-1.24倍）。在Loihi-1硬件上，每次推理的能量开销可达14μJ到13.24mJ，证明了持续部署的边缘系统中可复用的通用扰动会造成显著的电池消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNN因其稀疏二进制脉冲通信赋予的能效优势而被用于低功耗边缘系统，但这一效率优势同时带来了独特的安全风险。此前对SNN的输入空间效率攻击仅限于率编码（rate-coded）设置的逐样本优化，尚未覆盖原生事件驱动（event-based）的二进制输入场景。作者旨在填补这一空白，揭示事件驱动SNN面临的效率攻击威胁。

Method: 作者提出了两种攻击模型：(1) 逐样本海绵攻击：针对每个输入样本，通过基于梯度的优化方法定制对抗性脉冲序列，以最大化推理过程中的脉冲活动和突触运算量（SynOps）；(2) 通用海绵攻击：预先离线计算一个固定的二进制扰动，通过XOR操作应用到所有后续输入上，无需逐样本优化。实验在NMNIST、SHD和IBM DVS Gesture三个数据集上的三个SNN模型上进行，并将SynOp膨胀映射为Loihi-1硬件的估计能量开销。

Result: 逐样本海绵攻击在三个数据集上将每次推理的SynOps提升了1.5-2.6倍，同时至少98%的被评估样本保持了预测类别不变。通用海绵攻击虽然效果较弱（SynOps提升1.09-1.24倍），但代表了更现实的部署威胁，因为无需逐输入优化。将SynOp膨胀映射到Loihi-1估计能量，每次推理的额外开销从14μJ到13.24mJ不等。

Conclusion: 原生事件驱动的SNN对实用化的输入空间效率攻击是脆弱的。可复用的通用扰动能够在持续部署的边缘系统中累积为显著的电池消耗，这意味着SNN的能效优势本身可以被武器化，对采用此类网络的关键边缘应用构成实际威胁。

Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) communicate through sparse binary spike events rather than dense activations, enabling energy-efficient inference on neuromorphic hardware and motivating their use in always-on, battery-powered edge systems. We show that this same efficiency advantage creates a distinct security risk: sponge attacks can increase inference-time spike activity and synaptic workload, inflating energy consumption while remaining difficult to detect through correctness-based monitoring alone. Prior input-space efficiency attacks on SNNs have focused on per-sample optimization, primarily in rate-coded settings. We extend this threat to native event-based binary inputs and study two attack models. First, we develop a per-sample sponge attack that crafts a custom adversarial spike train for each input via gradient-based optimization. This attack increases per-inference SynOps by 1.5-2.6x on three SNN models for the NMNIST, SHD, and IBM DVS Gesture datasets, while preserving the predicted class on at least 98% of evaluated samples. Second, to the best of our knowledge, we introduce the first universal sponge attack for native event-based SNN inputs: a fixed binary perturbation computed offline and applied via XOR to all subsequent inputs. Although weaker, it still inflates SynOps by 1.09-1.24x across all three datasets and represents a more realistic deployment threat because it requires no per-input optimization. Mapping SynOp inflation to estimated Loihi-1 energy yields per-inference overheads from 14 $μ$J to 13.24 mJ. These results show that native event-based SNNs are vulnerable to practical input-space efficiency attacks, and that reusable universal perturbations can accumulate into meaningful battery drain in continuously deployed edge systems.

</details>


### [323] [Temporal Poisoning: Clean-Label Backdoors via Event Redistribution in SNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28075)
*Roberto Riaño,Gorka Abad,Stjepan Picek,Aitor Urbieta*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次研究了脉冲神经网络（SNN）上的干净标签时序投毒后门攻击。攻击仅对目标类别训练流施加固定时间戳变换，不改变标签，且保持逐像素逐极性事件计数完全一致，使得时序聚合后干净样本与触发样本无法区分，但在序列级别改变SNN的处理过程。在三种神经形态数据集及卷积和Transformer两类受害模型上，最强配置下攻击成功率（ASR）达到1.00。实验还通过投毒预算和触发形状消融分析攻击特性，并评估了适配脉冲模型的既有防御方法：时序折叠类防御在构造上即为盲区，特征空间方法仅在特定设置下能检测投毒。作者提出的基于每步事件质量的无模型检测器能检测所评估的时序变换，展示了率折叠防御的局限性及攻击隐蔽性的边界。这是首个在SNN和神经形态事件数据上评估的干净标签后门攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SNN后门攻击主要基于脏标签投毒（dirty-label poisoning），即带触发器的训练样本被重新标注为攻击者选定类别。作者旨在探索更隐蔽的攻击场景——干净标签投毒，即在保持标签不变的情况下实现后门注入，研究SNN在这一更严苛威胁模型下的安全漏洞。

Method: 提出一种干净标签时序投毒方法：仅对目标类别训练流施加固定时间戳变换，保持每像素每极性事件计数完全不变（因此时序聚合后不可区分），但改变SNN实际处理的序列顺序。在三种神经形态数据集上对卷积和Transformer两类受害者模型实施攻击，并通过投毒预算和触发形状消融分析攻击特性，同时评估了适配SNN的既有防御及自研的无模型逐步事件质量检测器。

Result: 在最强配置下攻击成功率（ASR）达到1.00。时序折叠类防御由于固定时间聚合的构造使其无法检测该攻击；特征空间方法仅在特定设置下有效；所提出的无模型基于逐步事件质量的检测器能够检测所评估的时序变换。

Conclusion: 研究表明SNN同样面临干净标签后门攻击的威胁，且时序域的信息是检测此类攻击的关键。时序折叠类防御存在先天盲区，而基于逐步事件质量的检测手段可以揭露此类时序投毒，展示了攻击隐蔽性与可检测性之间的边界。

Abstract: Backdoor attacks on Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have primarily assumed dirty-label poisoning, in which triggered training samples are relabeled to an attacker-selected class. We study clean-label temporal poisoning, where a fixed timestamp transformation is applied only to the target-class training streams, leaving their labels unchanged. The transformation preserves the per-pixel, per-polarity event count exactly, making clean and triggered samples identical after temporal aggregation while altering the sequence processed by the SNN. Across three neuromorphic datasets and both convolutional and transformer-based victims, the attack reaches an ASR of 1.00 in the strongest configurations. We analyze the attack through poison-budget and trigger-shape ablations and evaluate established backdoor defenses adapted to spiking models. Defenses that collapse the time axis before inspection are blind by construction, while feature-space methods detect the poison only in selected settings.
