Our model-free detector, based on per-step event mass, detects the evaluated temporal transformations, demonstrating both the limitation of rate-collapsed defenses and the boundary of the attack's stealth. To our knowledge, this is the first clean-label backdoor attack evaluated on SNNs and neuromorphic event data.

</details>


### [324] [Checking Information Flow in Cloud-based IoT Access Control Policies (Extended Version)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28088)
*Lorenzo Ceragioli,Letterio Galletta,Edoardo Lunati*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种形式化分析物联网访问控制策略的方法，通过建模AWS IoT Core组件并构建信息流图来识别设备间非预期的信息流动安全漏洞，并实现了工具IOT:POKER进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云计算提供商（如AWS IoT Core）的访问控制机制配置对安全性至关重要，但仅孤立地验证设备权限是不够的——在设备具有不同信任级别或处于不同子系统的场景中，需要进一步分析设备间是否存在非预期的信息流动路径。

Method: 首先形式化建模AWS IoT Core的组件，然后定义信息流图来捕捉访问控制策略所允许的设备间通信。通过利用SMT求解器构建图的有限表示，从而实现对设备间信息流的验证，并将该方法实现为工具IOT:POKER。

Result: 在现实场景和多个真实世界策略上评估了IOT:POKER工具，验证了该方法能够有效识别访问控制策略中的潜在信息流安全漏洞。

Conclusion: 该方法通过将信息流分析与SMT求解相结合，提供了一种系统化的方式来验证IoT云环境中跨设备的信息流安全性，弥补了传统权限孤立验证的不足。

Abstract: Many cloud providers for IoT technologies offer access control mechanisms whose proper configuration is critical for security. However, verifying permissions in isolation is insufficient in a setting where devices have different levels of trust or are compartmentalised in various subsystems. This work analyses IoT access control policies to identify potential security vulnerabilities from unwanted information flow between devices. To this end, we formally model AWS IoT Core's components and define an information flow graph to capture the communication among devices permitted by the access control policies. We build a finite representation of the graph by leveraging an SMT solver, thus enabling the verification of information flow between devices. We implement our approach in a tool called IOT:POKER, and assess it on a realistic scenario and several real-world policies.

</details>


### [325] [Agent Harness Distillation: Inference-Time Harness Extraction and Exploitation in Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28147)
*Yu Cui,Wuli Yang,Yirui Shi,Junhao Xia,Hui Jiang,Lei Gao,Chenfu Bao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的安全威胁框架Agent Harness Distillation (AHD)，用于量化大规模语言模型驱动的自主多智能体系统（AMAS）中推理时harness（编排框架）的知识产权泄露风险，并通过黑盒交互蒸馏提取目标代理的harness能力，同时提出基于欺骗的防御方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究已考察静态多智能体系统中的IP泄露问题，但AMAS中的推理时harness行为是动态涌现的，是否也存在类似风险尚不清楚。推理时harness作为重要的知识产权，其构建需要大量工程和计算资源，但针对此类动态系统的安全威胁研究存在空白。

Method: AHD框架分为两个阶段：预蒸馏阶段（pre-distillation）通过黑盒交互从目标代理的响应中推断推理时harness行为并构建初始harness；后蒸馏阶段（post-distillation）通过迭代细化初始harness，使其与目标代理的行为模式对齐。此外提出基于欺骗的防御策略。

Result: 在多个骨干LLM上的真实AMAS实验中验证了AHD的有效性，揭示了显著的知识产权泄露风险，同时基于欺骗的防御方法能够在保持受保护代理实用性的同时降低harness提取的有效性。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了一个此前未被充分探索的AMAS安全威胁——推理时harness提取问题，为自主多智能体系统的知识产权保护提供了新的研究方向和防御思路。

Abstract: Autonomous multi-agent systems (AMAS) built on large language models (LLMs), such as Hermes, increasingly rely on inference-time harnesses to coordinate reasoning and action. Constructing these harnesses requires substantial engineering effort and computational resources, as they are iteratively optimized over a combinatorial search space while co-evolving with the underlying LLM. Inference-time harnesses therefore constitute valuable intellectual property (IP). Although prior work has investigated IP leakage in static multi-agent systems with pre-configured architectures, it remains unclear whether similar risks arise in AMAS, where harness behavior emerges dynamically during inference. To address this gap, we introduce Agent Harness Distillation (AHD), a framework for studying the security risks arising from inference-time harness extraction in AMAS. We formalize harness extraction as a new security problem and develop an evaluation framework for quantifying such risks. AHD extracts inference-time harness capabilities from a target agent through black-box interactions and consists of two stages. In the pre-distillation stage, AHD infers inference-time harness behaviors from the responses of the target agent and constructs an initial harness. In the post-distillation stage, AHD iteratively refines the initial harness to align with the behavioral patterns of the target agent. Experiments on real-world AMAS across multiple backbone LLMs demonstrate the effectiveness of AHD and reveal substantial IP leakage risks. We further propose a deception-based defense that reduces harness extraction effectiveness while preserving the utility of the protected agent. Our findings uncover a previously underexplored security threat to AMAS.

</details>


### [326] [Piggybacking on Perception: Stealthy Concurrent Audio Prompt Injections against Multimodal LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28165)
*Mingxiao Liu,Yitong Li,Haoren Zhao,Yaoxiang Bian,Jianan Ma,Jian Zhang,Jialuo Chen,Xinhao Deng,Zhen Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了针对LLM驱动的多模态智能体的并发音频提示注入攻击，提出了指令增强和场景隐蔽两种新技术，构建了包含8个真实任务场景和10种攻击模式的综合基准AudioAgentSecurity，并提出了基于声源分离和一致性分析的级联防御机制CADV，在11个最新智能体上验证了攻击有效性和防御可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的多模态智能体通过连续音频交互执行自主任务已成为新范式，但音频输入不可避免包含超出用户控制的环境噪声，这引入了未被充分探索的关键攻击面。现有研究缺乏对音频提示注入攻击的系统性量化与分析，亟需全面评估该威胁并提出有效防御。

Method: 提出两种攻击技术：指令增强（instruction augmentation）和场景隐蔽（scenario concealment），使恶意音频指令能无缝嵌入用户语音中。构建AudioAgentSecurity基准，涵盖8个真实任务场景和10种攻击模式。提出CADV防御机制，基于级联音频解耦（声源分离）和跨模态一致性分析来检测音频指令注入。

Result: 在11个最新智能体（包括Gemini 3 Pro和GPT-4o-audio）上评估，攻击方法对Gemini 3 Pro的平均攻击成功率（ASR）达69.10%。CADV防御在多种攻击向量上实现超过90%的检测成功率。真实世界实验在豆包AI智能手机上确认了攻击的高隐蔽性和有效性，并验证了防御的可靠性。

Conclusion: 并发音频提示注入攻击对多模态智能体构成严重且隐蔽的安全威胁，现有的提示级防御不足以应对。基于声源分离和跨模态一致性分析的CADV机制能更稳健地检测此类攻击，为该领域提供了首个系统性基准和有效防御方案。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-driven multimodal agents are increasingly deployed to execute autonomous tasks via continuous audio interaction. While this paradigm enhances interaction naturalness, it introduces a critical yet under-explored attack surface, as audio inputs inevitably contain environmental noise beyond user control. In this paper, we investigate concurrent audio prompt injection attacks targeting multimodal agents. Distinct from traditional acoustic attacks on voice devices, we propose novel techniques for instruction augmentation and scenario concealment. These methods allow malicious audio instructions to imperceptibly "piggyback" onto user speech, thereby hijacking agents to execute malicious actions. To systematically quantify this threat, we construct AudioAgentSecurity, the first comprehensive benchmark for audio instruction injection attacks, encompassing 8 real-world task scenarios and 10 distinct attack patterns. We evaluate 11 state-of-the-art agents, including Gemini 3 Pro and GPT-4o-audio. Notably, our methods achieve an average Attack Success Rate (ASR) of 69.10\% against the advanced Gemini 3 Pro. To counter this threat, we further introduce Cascaded Audio Decoupling and Verification (CADV), a defense mechanism based on source separation and consistency analysis. Compared with existing prompt-level defenses, CADV leverages acoustic source separation and cross-modal consistency analysis to detect audio instruction injections more robustly, achieving over 90\% detection success across diverse attack vectors. Finally, real-world experiments with human volunteers on Doubao AI Smartphone in diverse dynamic real-world scenarios confirm the attacks' high stealth and efficacy, while demonstrating that our defense reliably mitigates these vulnerabilities.

</details>


### [327] [Security of World-Model-Based Embodied AI: A Lifecycle of Threats, Defenses, and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28226)
*Fazhong Liu,Zhuoyan Chen,Haozhen Tan,Yan Meng,Guoxing Chen,Haojin Zhu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文是对具身AI世界模型安全性的系统性综述，从全生命周期视角梳理威胁、攻防映射与防御框架，指出世界模型既是预测核心也是新的安全边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型为具身AI提供了预测核心，但这一预测层引入了新的安全边界——攻防可以从数据、传感器、提示或反馈传播至物理动作。现有研究往往将世界模型视为孤立组件，缺乏对其全生命周期安全威胁的系统性分析。

Method: 提出生命周期分类法（lifecycle taxonomy），涵盖从数据构建、表示学习、状态接地、想象推理、轨迹评估、执行到通过记忆和工具进行长期适应的全过程；将已有攻击（投毒、后门、对抗样本、传感器欺骗、提示注入、轨迹操纵、供应链攻击）映射到世界模型的安全属性；设计安全失败评估协议，并构建覆盖provenance、鲁棒接地、不确定性感知预测、轨迹门控、反馈审计和部署保障的防御分类体系。

Result: 展示了熟悉的攻击家族在世界模型语境下（如破坏世界状态、学习动力学、可得性估计或安全成本）具有不同含义；揭示了一个双重性：世界模型既可作为运行时安全盾牌，又可能在被破坏或过度信任时产生预测性安全幻觉（predictive safety illusions）。

Conclusion: 该综述为世界模型安全提供了完整的生命周期威胁框架，明确了攻击与安全属性的映射关系以及分层防御结构，为后续研究和评估奠定基础。

Abstract: World models give embodied AI a predictive core: they compress observations into states, simulate action-conditioned futures, and enable planning beyond reactive control. This predictive layer, however, opens a new security boundary-compromise can propagate from data, sensors, prompts, or feedback into physical action. Rather than treating world models as an isolated component, this survey traces threats across their entire lifecycle-from data construction and representation learning, through state grounding and imagination, to trajectory evaluation, execution, and long-term adaptation via memory and tools. We show that familiar attack families: poisoning, backdoors, adversarial examples, sensor spoofing, prompt injection, trajectory manipulation, and supply-chain attacks take on distinct meanings when they corrupt world states, learned dynamics, affordance estimates, or safety costs. We also highlight a duality: world models can serve as runtime safety shields, yet when compromised or over-trusted they generate predictive safety illusions. The survey offers a lifecycle taxonomy, maps existing attacks to world-model security properties, outlines evaluation protocols for safety failures, and structures defenses across provenance, robust grounding, uncertainty-aware prediction, trajectory gating, feedback auditing, and deployment assurance.

</details>


### [328] [Implementing Homomorphic Encryption-Based Logic Locking in System-on-Chip Designs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28542)
*Ye Ziyang,Makoto Ikeda*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于二进制带误差环学习（RLWE）算法的逻辑锁定方案，应用于RISC-V系统级芯片设计中，在特权切换过程中保护关键逻辑路径而不暴露锁定参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统逻辑锁定方法需要向用户提供原始锁定参数，存在参数暴露的安全风险。本研究旨在通过密码学方法（RLWE）保护关键逻辑路径，同时不泄露敏感锁定参数。

Method: 采用二进制RLWE算法设计逻辑锁定模块，将其集成到RISC-V SoC中，用于保护特权切换过程中的关键逻辑路径。锁定模块使用3519个LUT和2645个寄存器，解锁过程约需2.6微秒。

Result: 相比基线系统，整体开销为LUT增加6.0%、寄存器增加6.9%。解锁过程耗时约2.6微秒，主要影响系统级操作，用户级计算效率基本保持。

Conclusion: 该方案在引入适度硬件开销和性能影响的前提下，能够在不暴露锁定参数的情况下有效保护RISC-V系统的关键逻辑路径，实现安全的逻辑锁定。

Abstract: This study presents a logic locking scheme based on the binary Ring Learning With Errors algorithm, implemented in a RISC-V System-on-Chip design. Unlike traditional logic locking methods that require providing users with raw locking parameters, the proposed approach secures critical logic paths in the privilege switching process without exposing these sensitive parameters. The implemented locking module itself consumes 3519 Look-Up Tables and 2645 Registers, leading to an overall overhead of 6.0% in Look-Up Tables and 6.9% in Registers compared to the baseline system. The unlock process requires about 2.6 us, introducing moderate performance impact, primarily affecting system-level operations while preserving user-level computational efficiency.

</details>


### [329] [Formalization of security](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28551)
*Gilles Barthe*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本章探讨了证明助手在系统安全、基于语言的安全、安全编译和密码学等领域的应用，强调其验证设计和实现满足预期安全属性以及支持认证的动机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 证明助常常被用于验证设计和实现是否满足预期的安全属性，其另一动机是为安全认证提供支持。

Method: 本章聚焦于证明助手在四个具体领域的应用：系统安全、基于语言的安全、安全编译和密码学。

Result: 本章对这些领域的证明助手应用进行了系统性综述和介绍。

Conclusion: 证明助手在多个安全相关领域发挥重要作用，既能验证安全属性，也能支持安全认证过程。

Abstract: Proof assistants are often used to validate that designs and implementations meet their expected security properties. A further motivation for using proof assistants is to support certification. This chapter focuses on their applications to system security, language-based security, secure compilation, and cryptography.

</details>

### [330] [Multi-scale measures of time-varying epidemic spread on human mobility networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28514)
*Cathal Mills,Benjamin Reddy,William S. Hart,Robin N. Thompson,Kris V. Parag,Moritz U. G. Kraemer,Christl A. Donnelly,Ben Lambert*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于网络的建模框架，从机制出发推导新的更新方程，将日内人类移动直接整合到再生数R(t)的定义中，构建了从位置、位置间、汇聚场所到整个移动网络的多尺度瞬时再生数家族，并利用手机数据展示了其在多尺度疫情控制指标设计和时空精准干预中的应用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推断瞬时再生数R(t)的理论和工具通常假设人群静态或均匀混合，无法描述个体根据日内移动模式异质性地产生和获得感染的过程。位置特定的R(t)估计器在封闭、静态人群中适用，但在现实移动网络中会存在偏差，缺乏将日内人类移动纳入再生数推断的机制性框架。

Method: 开发一个基于网络的建模框架，从该框架推导出由机制驱动的更新方程及疫情控制指标；方程直接整合日内人类移动，严格定义一族瞬时再生数（内向、外向和类型R(t)用于个体位置，位置间R(t)，汇聚场所R(t)以及整个移动网络的R(t)）；通过在多种类型网络上的疫情模拟以及手机移动数据对框架进行验证。

Result: 该框架在多种网络和手机数据上的应用表明，新的多尺度控制指标可在网络、位置和传播走廊尺度提供控制干预设计依据，包括所需干预的强度、类型和时长在时空上的配置；框架还捕获了现有测量位置特定及网络级传播潜势方法在未纳入日内人类移动时的偏差效应。

Conclusion: 该可泛化的框架将再生数重新定义于受人类跨位置移动塑造的现实疫情场景中，使干预措施在空间和时间上更加精准，为传染病实时疫情监测和控制提供了新的机制性理论基础。

Abstract: Human movement drives the spatial spread and persistence of many infectious diseases, yet existing theory and real-time operational tools for inferring the instantaneous reproduction number R(t) often assume static and/or homogeneously mixing populations and cannot describe how individuals generate and acquire infections heterogeneously based on their movement patterns within a day. Renewal equations underpin many such popular estimators of R(t), and here, we develop a network-based modelling framework from which we derive new mechanism-led renewal equations and control indicators for outbreaks of infectious diseases. These equations directly integrate within-day human movement to rigorously define a family of instantaneous reproduction numbers; inward, outward, and type R(t) for individual locations, R(t) between locations, R(t) at meeting locations, and R(t) for the entire mobility network. These quantities correct for the unsuitability of existing location-specific R(t) estimators that operate in closed, static populations. Applying our framework to epidemics on diverse types of networks alongside mobile phone data, we demonstrate how our new framework's outputs provide new, multi-scale control indicators at the network, location, and transmission corridor scales, and can be used to design targeted disease control interventions including the strength, type, and length of intervention required across space and time. We capture the biasing effects of different existing ways to measure location-specific and network-level transmission potential without capturing within-day human movements. This generalisable framework redefines reproduction numbers in real-world outbreaks that are shaped by individuals moving across connected locations, enabling more spatially and temporally precise interventions.

</details>

### [331] [PlantBGC: Transformer for Plant BGC Discovery via Label-Free Domain Adaptation and Weak Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27258)
*Yuhan Zhao,Nidhi Grover,Zhishan Guo,Ning Sui*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: PlantBGC是一个基于编码器Transformer的植物生物合成基因簇(BGC)预测工具，将基因组表示为有序Pfam结构域序列，利用MIBiG微生物BGC迁移学习并通过无标签掩码语言建模适配植物基因组。在微生物基准上实现token级AUC=0.988；在植物上，域适应将已知BGC恢复率从29.4%提升至67.6%，GO/KEGG弱监督将原代样比例降低约45-48%，并产出比plantiSMASH更紧凑的基因簇。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 植物BGC的注释标签稀缺，阻碍了全基因组规模的监督式发现；现有植物BGC挖掘工具主要依赖特征签名和规则驱动，未能充分利用上下文表征学习来建模长程结构域上下文并控制领域偏移下的假阳性。作者旨在构建AI辅助工作流，通过从注释完善的微生物BGC迁移监督信号来缩小实验搜索空间。

Method: 将基因组表示为有序的Pfam结构域序列，采用编码器-only Transformer学习BGC相似性。模型先在MIBiG微生物BGC上训练，再通过无标签掩码语言建模(MLM)适应植物基因组。此外，利用GO/KEGG注释导出弱监督信号来进一步优化预测，降低非BGC区域的误报。

Result: 微生物基准上token级AUC=0.988(10折交叉验证)和0.979(留类验证)。在植物34个精选位点上，域适应使严格100%覆盖下的已知BGC恢复率从29.4%提升至67.6%。GO/KEGG弱监督将代理原代样比例分别降低48.40%和45.20%，配对Wilcoxon检验p=1.53e-5。与plantiSMASH相比，在匹配区域上PlantBGC产出的基因座更紧凑（中位长度比0.278，93.8%的配对更短）。

Conclusion: PlantBGC展示了跨领域（微生物到植物）迁移学习在BGC挖掘中的有效性，域适应显著提升已知位点恢复率并改善边界识别，弱监督有效抑制假阳性。相比传统规则工具plantiSMASH，PlantBGC能产出更紧凑、更准确的基因簇注释，可有效缩小实验验证的搜索空间。

Abstract: Plant biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) encode specialized-metabolite pathways, yet curated plant BGC labels remain scarce, hindering supervised discovery at genome scale. Existing plant BGC mining tools are largely signature- and rule-driven and do not fully leverage recent advances in contextual representation learning for modeling long-range domain context and controlling false positives under strong domain shift. We seek an AI-assisted workflow that narrows experimental search space by transferring supervision from well-annotated microbial BGCs to plant genomes. We present PlantBGC, representing genomes as ordered Pfam-domain sequences and learning BGC-likeness with an encoder-only Transformer trained on MIBiG microbial BGCs and adapted to plants via label-free masked language modeling. On microbial benchmarks, PlantBGC achieves token-level AUC = 0.988 (10-fold CV) and 0.979 (leave-class-out). On plants, adaptation improves known-BGC recovery on n = 34 curated loci under strict 100% coverage, increasing recovery from 29.4% to 67.6% and indicating more complete boundaries. GO/KEGG-derived weak supervision reduces proxy primary-like ratio by 48.40% (GO) and 45.20% (KEGG), with consistent per-species reductions (paired Wilcoxon p = 1.53e-5). Compared to plantiSMASH, PlantBGC yields more compact loci on matched regions (median length ratio = 0.278; 93.8% of pairs are shorter).

</details>

### [332] [Stimulus-Evoked Network Dynamics in Human Cortical Organoids: From a Graph-Computational Framework to Repeated-Stimulation Depression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28068)
*Esmaeil S. Nadimi,Vinay C. Gogineni,Jan-Matthias Braun,Martin Røssel Larsen,Victoria Blanes-Vidal,Helle Bogetofte Barnkob*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文开发了一套图计算框架用于量化人类皮层类器官中刺激诱发的信号传播，发现类器官的诱发响应是近乎同步的网络爆发而非向外传播，并揭示了重复每日刺激会进行性抑制并空间收缩诱发响应这一控制验证的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类皮层类器官是研究早期神经环路形成的实验模型，但其活动是否反映结构化信息处理而非自发同步尚不清楚。作者希望通过图计算方法定量刻画刺激诱发的信号传播，以区分这两类可能性。

Method: 开发了包含刺激条件功能图、图约束动力学（图神经网络）模型作为系统辨识工具、生物消息传递原则（将整合深度限制于可观测传播深度）以及一套图级指标的计算框架，并在三个类器官的纵向HD-MEA记录上完整执行。

Result: 恢复真实采样率和刺激时序后，诱发响应是快速、近乎同步的网络爆发，无可测的外向传播（峰潜伏期-距离斜率为0），传播/整合深度指标不适用；在可用试验次数下逐日连接图无法可靠估计。改用同步性框架后发现重复每日刺激进行性抑制并空间收缩诱发响应，第7天首次受刺激的类器官激活93%阵列，而有五次先前刺激的类器官仅激活10%。

Conclusion: 类器官诱发活动的主要特征不是空间传播而是同步化爆发，重复刺激会重塑并抑制类器官网络；由于纵向设计中每个制备都被刺激，必须引入发育匹配、刺激天真的对照来分离重复刺激效应与发育成熟效应，作者通过此设计打破了该混杂因素。

Abstract: Human cortical organoids provide an experimentally accessible model of early neural circuit formation, yet whether their activity reflects structured information processing rather than spontaneous synchronization is unclear. We developed a graph-computational framework to quantify stimulus-evoked propagation. This includes stimulus-conditioned functional graphs, a graph-constrained dynamical (graph-neural-network) model used as a system-identification tool, a biological message-passing principle bounding integration depth by observable propagation depth, and a suite of graph-level metrics. We carried this program out in full on longitudinal HD-MEA recordings from three organoids. Once the true acquisition sampling rate and stimulus timing were recovered, the evoked response proved to be a fast, near-synchronous network burst with no measurable outward propagation (peak-latency vs. distance slope = 0). The propagation/integration-depth metrics (Deff ,reachability index, dmax) therefore do not apply, and per-day connectivity graphs were not reliably estimable at the available trial count, a negative result with methodological consequences for applying such metrics to organoid data. Reframing around synchrony, response-population size and shared variability revealed a control-validated phenomenon, i.e., repeated daily stimulation progressively depressed and spatially contracted the evoked response. That repeated stimulation reshapes organoid networks is established, but longitudinal designs in which every preparation is stimulated cannot separate this from developmental maturation. We break that confound with a developmentally-matched, stimulation-naive control, where at day 7, an organoid receiving its first-ever stimulation engaged 93% of the array, whereas organoids with five prior sessions engaged 10%.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

### [333] [It's Not Just More Demos: Counterfactual Action Sensitivity Coverage for Data-Efficient Robust Robot Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27261)
*Giovanni D'urso,Kaushik Roy,Nicholas Lawrance,Brendan Tidd*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Counterfactual Nuisance Behaviour Cloning (CFNBC)，一种离线数据选择框架，通过量化策略在视觉干扰下的动作漂移（action drift）来定向修复模仿学习策略的脆弱性，仅需20-30个精选样本即可大幅提升鲁棒性，媲美甚至超越更大规模随机数据集的修复效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉运动模仿学习策略对任务无关的视觉干扰（如光照、颜色、场景杂讯）极其敏感，微小变化即可导致性能严重退化。虽然增加数据多样性可以提升鲁棒性，但缺乏明确指导：对于已训练好的策略，哪些额外演示数据才是真正有信息量的？需要一个策略特定的、可离线执行的定向数据选择机制。

Method: CFNBC包含三个核心步骤：(1) 基于名义策略生成配对的反事实观测（干净与带干扰的观测对），这些观测对应的专家动作保持一致；(2) 测量动作漂移（action drift），即策略在不应改变行为的干扰条件下预测动作的变化幅度，作为策略特定敏感性信号；(3) 利用该信号从更大候选池中挑选紧凑且响应多样的修复集，整个过程无需在线执行策略或依赖轨迹成功标签。

Result: 在MuJoCo双臂立方体搬运和SimplerEnv立方体堆叠任务中：(1) 动作漂移与干扰导致的失败率显著相关；(2) 基于响应引导的修复仅需20-30个精选候选样本即可大幅超越同等预算的随机选择；(3) 其性能接近使用更大规模随机修复预算的效果。

Conclusion: 数据中心的鲁棒性修复观：最有用的额外数据并非数量最多、视觉多样性最大或表面难度最高，而是那些覆盖当前策略脆弱响应模式的样本。CFNBC为离线、无需执行监督的定向鲁棒性修复提供了有效工具。

Abstract: Visuomotor imitation learning has demonstrated success for manipulation tasks. However, the trained policies remain brittle to visual `nuisances', with even minor task-preserving variations such as lighting, distractions or changes in colour result in heavy degradation of the trained policy's performance. While increasing data diversity can improve robustness, it is unclear which additional demonstrations are informative for a particular trained policy. We propose Counterfactual Nuisance Behaviour Cloning (CFNBC), an offline data-selection framework for targeted robustness repair. Starting from a nominal policy trained on `clean' demonstrations, CFNBC generates paired clean and nuisance observations that preserve the expert action, then measures \emph{action drift}: the change in the policy's predicted action under a nuisance that should not alter the desired behaviour. This provides a policy-specific sensitivity signal for selecting a compact, response-diverse repair set from a larger candidate pool, without requiring rollout success labels or online policy execution. We show in MuJoCo bimanual cube transfer and SimplerEnv cube stacking that action drift correlates with nuisance-induced failure, and that response-guided repair with only $20$--$30$ selected candidates substantially outperforms matched-budget random selection while approaching the performance of much larger random repair budgets. These results support a data-centric view of robustness repair: the most useful data are not necessarily the most numerous, visually diverse, or obviously difficult, but the examples that cover fragile response modes of the current policy.

</details>


### [334] [Simulation of Surgical Suturing Using Position-Based Dynamics and the Material Point Method for Robot Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27494)
*Tleukhan Mussin,Yafei Ou,Mahdi Tavakoli*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于PBD缝线与MPM软组织的缝合仿真环境，实现双向接触耦合，支持GPU并行加速，并构建了用于自主缝合子任务的强化学习环境，成功率达到80%（插针）和68%（拔针）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术机器人研究亟需高性能仿真器，但软组织缝合的完整场景（包括缝线与软组织接触）很少被建模。现有研究大多独立模拟缝线或软组织，缺乏对缝合全流程的仿真支持。

Method: 采用位置动力学（PBD）建模缝线，物质点法（MPM）建模软组织，设计PBD缝线与MPM软组织之间的双向接触耦合方法，纳入摩擦力和拖曳力；利用多个CUDA流在GPU上并行优化仿真场景；基于ML-Agents构建强化学习环境，训练自主缝合子任务（插针、驱动、拔针）。

Result: RL智能体在仿真器中实现稳定学习，在最严格距离阈值下插针和拔针任务的成功率分别达到80%和68%。

Conclusion: 该仿真环境能够实现视觉上合理的缝线-组织交互，并为自主缝合的强化学习训练提供了高效、可扩展的平台。

Abstract: Recent advances in robotics research have created a strong demand for high-performance simulators. Surgical robotics simulation faces unique challenges due to the need to model diverse objects, such as rigid instruments, soft tissue, and fluids. While many studies simulate sutures or soft tissue independently, only a few have considered the complete soft-tissue suturing scenario, including the contact between sutures and deformable tissue during suture insertion. Building on previous work, this paper presents a novel suturing simulation environment using sutures modelled by position-based dynamics (PBD) and soft bodies modelled by the material point method (MPM) while considering two-way contact with frictional and drag forces. We introduce a contact coupling method between the PBD suture and the MPM soft tissue, enabling visually plausible suture-tissue interactions. The simulator is optimized for GPU execution with parallel scenes using multiple CUDA streams, and we present a Reinforcement Learning (RL) environment for autonomous suturing sub-tasks, including needle insertion, driving, and extraction. Using ML-Agents, RL agents trained in the simulator show stable learning and achieve 80% and 68% success rates in needle insertion and extraction, respectively, under the strictest distance threshold.

</details>


### [335] [Corrigible Assistance in One Round: Pragmatic-Pedagogic Best Response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27508)
*Elle Lazarski,Jaime Fernández Fisac*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文识别了一类"协助博弈"（assistance games），在此类博弈中，实用-教学推理（pragmatic-pedagogic reasoning）能在单步内消除目标不确定性，使得全时段博弈可通过可处理的best-response过程精确求解。论文证明了主流逆最优控制在此类博弈中存在推理上限，而实用-教学推理通过教学性动作超越该限制，并在协作积木搭建示例中验证了理论结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类-机器人协作中，机器人需在不完全信息下推断人类目标并实施协助。通用协助博弈的最优策略需在POMDP中规划，在线计算不可行（intractable）。因此需要识别可精确求解的协助博弈子类，并找到高效且能克服传统方法局限的推理机制。

Method: 论文首先界定了一类特殊协助博弈，其结构使得实用-教学推理能够在单个时间步内消解目标不确定性。在此基础上，将全时段博弈转化为可通过可计算的best-response过程精确求解的问题。同时，论文对比了主流逆最优控制（inverse optimal control）方法与所提出的实用-教学推理方法，揭示前者的"推理天花板"。

Result: 在所识别的协助博弈类别中：（1）全时段协助博弈被证明可通过可处理的best-response过程精确求解；（2）主流逆最优控制由于仅基于任务执行视角进行推断，存在无法消除的目标歧义（推理天花板），阻碍人机对齐；（3）实用-教学推理通过产生在纯执行视角下等价、但具有教学传达性的动作，能立即消除目标不确定性，突破此限制；（4）在协作积木搭建的简单示例上验证了理论分析与所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 论文从理论上刻画了一类可精确求解的协助博弈，并证明实用-教学推理较传统逆最优控制在目标推断与人机对齐上具有本质优势，为高效的人机协作策略提供了新的理论框架与求解路径。

Abstract: Assistance games formalize human-robot collaboration under asymmetric information: the human knows the goal, while the robot must infer it from observation and interaction in order to assist effectively. In general, computing optimal assistance game strategies online is intractable, since exact solutions require planning in a POMDP. We identify a class of assistance games in which pragmatic-pedagogic reasoning resolves goal uncertainty in a single time step, rendering the full-horizon game exactly solvable by a tractable best-response procedure. Within this class, we show that mainstream inverse optimal control exhibits an inference ceiling that hinders alignment, while pragmatic-pedagogic reasoning overcomes this barrier by immediately disambiguating goals through actions that look equivalent under task execution alone. Finally, we validate our theoretical results and proposed method on a simple collaborative block-building example.

</details>


### [336] [Failure Detection for Surgical Robot Imitation Policies via Flow-Matching World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27511)
*Zhefeng Huang,Yilin Cai,Ankit Patel,Mohammad Hajiha,Brendan Browne,Yue Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出FoMo-FD，一种基于流匹配世界模型的失败检测方法，通过学习名义短时视觉动态并利用逆传输非一致性评分来检测视觉-动作不一致性，无需失败演示数据即可在手术机器人任务中实现高失败检出率和低误报率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模仿学习在自主机器人手术中展现出应用潜力，但手术任务的安全关键性以及环境的复杂性和变异性使其安全部署面临挑战。失败检测是必要的安全保障，然而开发失败检测器面临三大困难：失败数据稀缺、操作动态高度多变，以及需要在漏检与干扰性误报之间取得平衡。

Method: FoMo-FD首先利用动作条件流匹配世界模型学习名义（正常）短时视觉动态；然后通过计算观测到的端点潜变量的逆传输非一致性（inverse-transport nonconformity）进行评分，实现窗口级别的视觉-动作不一致性检测，无需失败演示样本；最后通过一致性校准（conformal calibration）在成功执行数据上获取检测阈值，为每个特定任务生成告警阈值，无需假设未来失败类型。

Result: 在dVRK上的四个手术相关操作任务和二十种失败模式（包含仿真和真实实验）中，FoMo-FD优于观察级别的异常检测基线以及同一世界模型的预测误差变体。其中腕部相机视角表现最佳，实现了96.6%的失败检出率（FDR）和仅1.3%的误报率（FAR）。

Conclusion: FoMo-FD通过流匹配世界模型与一致性校准的结合，在无需失败数据进行训练的前提下，有效解决了手术机器人模仿学习中失败检测的难题，在检测精度和误报控制之间取得了显著优于现有基线的平衡。

Abstract: Imitation learning has shown increasing promise for autonomous robotic surgery, yet safe deployment remains challenging due to the safety-critical nature of surgical tasks and the complexity and variability of surgical environments. Failure detection is therefore an essential safeguard, but its development remains difficult due to the challenges of scarce failure data, highly variable manipulation dynamics, and the need to balance missed detections against disruptive false alarms. To address these challenges, we introduce FoMo-FD (Flow-Matching World Model for Failure Detection), a failure detection method that learns nominal short-horizon visual dynamics with an action-conditioned flow-matching world model. FoMo-FD scores the inverse-transport nonconformity of observed endpoint latents, enabling window-level detection of visual-action inconsistencies without requiring failure demonstrations. Detection thresholds are obtained by conformal calibration on successful executions, yielding task-specific alarms without assuming future failure types. We evaluate FoMo-FD on four surgically relevant manipulation tasks with twenty failure modes across simulation and real-world experiments using the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK). Results show that FoMo-FD outperforms observation-level anomaly baselines and a prediction-error variant of the same world model, with the wrist-camera view achieving the strongest performance, including a 96.6% failure detection rate (FDR) at a 1.3% false alarm rate (FAR).

</details>


### [337] [Cross-Embodiment Transfer via Behavior-Aligned Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27549)
*Ajay Sridhar,Jensen Gao,Jonathan Yang,Jean Mercat,Suneel Belkhale,Dorsa Sadigh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究行为对齐表示（如物体边界框、语言动作、末端执行器轨迹）在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中对跨具身迁移的作用，发现末端执行器轨迹对迁移尤其有益，且表示在大规模先验数据集下更有用，并可利用无动作数据进行迁移，在真实机器人上提升了28%的任务完成进度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模模仿学习已推动机器人操作进步，但跨具身迁移仍然困难。作者希望探究行为对齐表示是否能因其跨具身不变性且对动作有预测力，帮助统一大规模跨具身数据以增强迁移能力。

Method: 构建了一个基于仿真的基准测试，用于评估在不同跨具身数据下对新具身的迁移性能。在该基准中对比多种行为对齐表示（物体边界框、语言运动、末端执行器轨迹）及不同的融入方式，并进行仿真到真实的迁移实验。

Result: 末端执行器轨迹对跨具身迁移特别有益；表示在更大的先验数据集下通常更有用；表示可用于利用无动作数据提升迁移；将仿真预训练策略应用于真实机器人时，任务完成进度提升了28%。

Conclusion: 行为对齐表示，尤其是末端执行器轨迹，是提升VLA模型跨具身迁移能力的有效手段，能够促进大规模跨具身数据集的统一利用，并在从仿真到真实的迁移中带来显著性能提升。

Abstract: Recent progress in large-scale imitation learning for robot manipulation has been driven by leveraging datasets across a wide range of robot embodiments. However, achieving significant cross-embodiment transfer is often still challenging. In this work, we study the role of using behavior-aligned representations (e.g., object bounding boxes, language motions, end-effector traces of robot motion) in vision-language-action (VLA) models to promote cross-embodiment transfer. We hypothesize that by possessing invariances across embodiments while being predictive of robot actions, these representations can help unify large-scale cross-embodiment data to enhance transfer. To assess our hypothesis, we develop a simulation-based benchmark designed to assess transfer with diverse cross-embodiment data to new embodiments. Using this benchmark, we compare different representations and ways of incorporating them. We identify that end-effector traces can be particularly beneficial for transfer, representations are generally more useful with larger prior datasets, and can be used to benefit from action-free data. We also demonstrate that they can enhance sim-to-real cross-embodiment transfer, improving task completion progress of real robot policies pre-trained on simulation data by 28%. We provide videos of our evaluations at our website: https://ajaysridhar.com/barx/.

</details>


### [338] [A Systems Engineering Framework for Vision-Language-Enabled UAV Triage and Disaster Response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27597)
*Swapnil Saha,Bhuvan Rajanasiriyur Jagadeesha,Karishma Patnaik,Neelakshi Majumdar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本研究探索将视觉语言模型（VLM）嵌入人-UAV协同回路中作为协调智能体的可行性，通过MBSE方法设计架构，并结合软件在环测试与七名参与者的人因评估，结果显示可降低感知工作负荷并提升AI信任度与通信清晰度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前VLM在灾害响应中的应用主要限于决策支持角色，如社交媒体监测、行动方案草拟和技术警报翻译。这些方案需要人类将输出转化为跨团队和机器人资产的协调行动，增加了操作员负担。因此，需要探索将VLM作为嵌入人-UAV回路中的协调智能体，而非仅作为咨询工具。

Method: 采用基于模型的系统工程（MBSE）方法开发架构，使用时序图和块定义图表示系统角色、内部结构和组件交互。实现了三个关键组件：VLM协调智能体、UAV任务控制和任务分配器，集成在仿真与控制环境中。最终通过七名参与者的人因评估验证系统性能。

Result: 七名参与者的初步人因评估显示，系统在心理需求、努力和挫败感方面的感知工作负荷降低，同时AI信任度和通信清晰度获得高评分。

Conclusion: 通过整合MBSE、软件在环测试和人因评估，本研究推进了高危机灾害响应中可扩展的人机自主协同，对航空航天自主性和民用安全具有更广泛的意义。

Abstract: Recent advances in Vision Language Models (VLMs) have created new opportunities for disaster response, where responders must interpret large volumes of sensor data under time pressure. Current VLM applications include social media monitoring for situational awareness, generation of draft action plans, and translation of technical alerts into public-facing messages. While these efforts can accelerate information flow, they remain largely limited to decision-support roles. Such approaches can increase operator burden because humans must still translate outputs into coordinated actions across teams and robotic assets. This study explores the viability of embedding VLMs as coordination agents within the human-UAV loop. The proposed architecture integrates natural language interaction, mission-level task coordination, software-in-the-loop implementation, and communication aligned with the Incident Command System (ICS). Rather than functioning solely as advisory tools, VLMs facilitate communication between human operators, mission control logic, and UAV task execution. The framework was developed using a Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) approach, with use case and block definition diagrams representing system roles, internal structure, and component interactions. Three key elements, the VLM Coordinator Agent, UAV Mission Control, and Task Allocator, were implemented within an integrated simulation and control environment. A preliminary human-factors evaluation with seven participants showed reduced perceived workload across mental demand, effort, and frustration, along with high ratings for AI trust and communication clarity. By integrating MBSE, software-in-the-loop testing, and human-factors evaluation, this work advances scalable human-autonomy teaming for high-stakes disaster response, with broader implications for aerospace autonomy and civil safety.

</details>


### [339] [Arm2Air: Cross-Embodiment Skeleton Transfer for 3D Relay Formation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27627)
*Dohun Lee,Kyeonghyun Yoo,Seokmin Kim,Byongho Lee,Seungjoo Oh,Hwangnam Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Arm2Air，一种通过跨具身迁移（cross-embodiment transfer）将机器人手臂的避障骨架知识迁移到UAV中继部署任务中的方法。利用预训练的Neural MP模型生成有序骨架，通过LoRA微调的Transformer平台适配到UAV域，在密集城市场景中显著降低了规划运行时并提升了中继链性能，同时实现了参数高效和样本高效的学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UAV中继网络在通信基础设施受损后可恢复连接，但城市环境中的中继部署需同时考虑视线遮挡、通信范围、飞行高度和三维障碍物，十分困难。现有的规划方法效率低且需要大量数据，因此需要一种计算高效且数据高效的中继放置方法。

Method: Arm2Air方法包括：(1)从机器人手臂的预训练神经运动规划(Neural MP)模型中提取避障骨架；(2)将骨架转换为有序结构，用于预训练一个基于Transformer的迁移平台；(3)通过少量目标域数据和低秩适配(LoRA)将平台适配到UAV域；(4)将迁移得到的骨架初始化中继链，并针对连通性、瓶颈容量、延迟和移动成本进行细化优化。

Result: 在9个高杂波3D城市地图上，Arm2Air相比最快的传统规划器将中位端到端规划运行时降低64.9%；在30个地图的高遮挡子集上，相比IMPC-MD，瓶颈容量提高32.6%，容量方差降低74.7%，最大跳距缩短13.2%，跳距方差降低75.2%，中继位移减少16.9%；仅用3个目标域训练地图，相比从头训练，中继位置RMSE降低53.6%，仅更新13.4万参数（对比从头训练和全微调的138.3万参数）。

Conclusion: Arm2Air实现了计算和数据高效的UAV中继部署，并揭示了一个更广泛的原则：有序结构先验可以在异构具身任务之间进行迁移，这为跨机器人的知识共享提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) relay networks can restore connectivity after communication infrastructure is damaged. Urban relay placement is difficult because line-of-sight blockage, communication range, altitude, and three-dimensional obstacles must be considered jointly. Arm2Air transfers obstacle-avoidance skeletons from robot arms to UAV relay placement through cross-embodiment transfer. Source-domain robot-arm motions from a pretrained Neural MP model are converted into ordered skeletons that pretrain a transformer-based transfer platform, which is then adapted to the UAV domain using limited target data and Low-Rank Adaptation. The transferred skeleton initializes a relay chain that is refined for connectivity, bottleneck capacity, delay, and movement cost. On nine held-out high-clutter 3D urban maps, Arm2Air reduced median end-to-end planning runtime by 64.9 percent relative to the fastest conventional planner. On the high-obstruction group of a separate 30-map dense urban holdout, it increased bottleneck capacity by 32.6 percent, reduced capacity variance by 74.7 percent, reduced maximum hop distance by 13.2 percent, reduced hop-distance variance by 75.2 percent, and reduced relay displacement by 16.9 percent relative to IMPC-MD. With only three target-domain training maps, Arm2Air reduced relay-position root mean square error by 53.6 percent relative to training from scratch while updating 0.134 million parameters, compared with 1.383 million for Scratch and Full Fine-tuning. These results demonstrate computationally and data-efficient UAV relay placement and suggest a broader principle for transferring ordered structural priors across heterogeneous embodied tasks.

</details>


### [340] [LabEvolver: Training-Free Experience Evolution for Safe and Grounded Wet-Lab Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27690)
*Jingya Wang,Yuyang Gao,Liuzhenghao Lv,Yonghong Tian,Yuyang Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LabEvolver是一个无需训练的框架，通过内外双循环机制为湿实验智能体赋予基于执行经验的记忆能力。内循环负责状态感知、在线规划和安全性验证，外循环将完成的轨迹蒸馏为可复用的技能、策略和安全经验。在机器人溶液制备任务中，pH调节完成时间减少48.2%，安全门拦截减少60.0%；在ALFWorld基准上，20步内累计成功率从ReAct的76.2%提升至91.4%，展示了超越湿实验场景的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 湿实验室自动化智能体（wet-lab agents）缺乏从过往执行经验中学习的能力，导致效率低下且安全性不足。现有方法通常需要大量训练数据或依赖预训练模型，难以在真实实验环境中实现在线自适应和持续改进。作者希望探索一种无需训练（training-free）的"干中学"（learn-by-doing）路径，使智能体能够通过积累执行经验逐步提升性能。

Method: LabEvolver采用双循环架构：内循环（inner trial loop）是状态锚定的试错过程，包含自适应感知、在线规划和安全性验证三个关键模块；外循环（outer evolution loop）则将已完成轨迹进行经验蒸馏，提取出可复用的技能（skill）、策略（strategy）和安全经验（safety experience），形成记忆库供后续任务复用。

Result: 在机器人溶液制备任务上，pH调节完成时间降低48.2%，安全门拦截次数减少60.0%，验证了真实环境可行性。在ALFWorld基准上，500个连续任务的20步内累计成功率从ReAct的76.2%提升至91.4%，表明该方法在湿实验之外也具有良好泛化能力。

Conclusion: LabEvolver证明了一种无需训练、基于执行经验演化（experience evolution）的路径可以驱动闭环自动科学发现，为安全且稳定的湿实验智能体的持续学习提供了一种可行范式和实现框架。

Abstract: We introduce LabEvolver, a training-free framework that equips safe and grounded wet-lab agents with episodic memory from execution experience. LabEvolver couples a state-grounded inner trial loop for adaptive perception, online planning, and safety validation with an outer evolution loop that distills completed trajectories into reusable skill, strategy, and safety experience. On robotic solution-preparation tasks, LabEvolver demonstrates real-world feasibility, reducing pH-regulation completion time and safety-gate intercepts by 48.2% and 60.0%, respectively. On ALFWorld, it further improves cumulative success rate within 20 steps from 76.2% with ReAct to 91.4% over 500 continual tasks, showing generality beyond wet-lab settings. These results support learn-by-doing experience evolution as a feasible path toward closed-loop automated scientific discovery. The project page is available at https://github.com/AndyGao6186/LabEvolver.

</details>


### [341] [Write-Safe Flow Field Mapping under Ambiguous Onboard Sensing and Localization Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27713)
*Linhao Jin,Qimin Feng,Peter Gunnarson,Qiang Zhong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种地图参考感知的保守融合框架，用于移动机器人在流场建图时避免因定位漂移和感知歧义导致的"幽灵结构"（错误注册的地图更新累积），通过学习写入安全分数连续衰减不确定更新，在合成射流和横向流环境中将幽灵污染降低42%，零样本硬件回放中进一步降低39%且保留81%地图覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人可以从机载传感推断局部流结构，但局部看似合理的估计写入全局地图时并不安全：相似流结构可能产生歧义观测，而定位漂移会导致预测补丁被写入错误位置，重复的错误注册更新会累积成持续的幽灵结构。现有方法未能有效解决这一失败模式。

Method: 提出一个地图参考感知的保守融合框架，包含两个核心组件：（1）预测局部速度场的模型；（2）一个学习的写入安全评分器，该评分器连续衰减不确定的地图更新，同时在没有可靠地图参考时允许进行地图初始化。该方法将写入安全性融入融合过程，实现保守的地图更新策略。

Result: 在合成射流和横向流环境中，该方法相比无门控融合将平均幽灵污染降低42%。在真实水推进器尾流中，使用真实压力和光流测量的零样本硬件回放进一步将幽灵污染降低39%，同时保留81%的地图覆盖率。

Conclusion: 安全的建图写入对于存在歧义感知和定位漂移的流动建图任务至关重要。所提出的地图参考感知保守融合框架有效缓解了幽灵结构问题，兼顾了地图更新质量与覆盖率，验证了该方法在真实场景中的泛化能力。

Abstract: Mobile robots can infer local flow structure from onboard sensing, but a locally plausible estimate is not always safe to write into a global map. Similar flow structures may produce ambiguous observations, while localization drift causes predicted patches to be written at incorrect locations. Repeated misregistered updates then accumulate into persistent ghost structures. We address this failure mode with a map-reference-aware conservative fusion framework. The model predicts a local velocity patch and a learned write-safety score that continuously attenuates uncertain map updates while permitting initialization when no reliable map reference is available. Across synthetic jet and crossflow environments, the proposed method reduces average ghost contamination by 42% relative to ungated fusion. A zero-shot hardware replay using real pressure and optical-flow measurements from a thruster wake further reduces ghost contamination by 39% while retaining 81% map coverage. These results show that safe map writing is critical for flow mapping under ambiguous sensing and localization drift.

</details>


### [342] [RedFlow: Redirect Failure into Action-Level Corrections for Flow-matching VLA Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27782)
*Zhengyang Yan,Junhao Li,Fangqi Zhu,Zijun Wang,Quanxin Shou,Yikun Miao,Xiaoyi Pang,Zicong Hong,Song Guo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RedFlow是一个面向流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的细粒度离线强化学习框架，通过将失败经验转化为动作级别的校正监督来缓解部署期间的分布偏移和复合误差。在LIBERO基准和三个真实世界操作任务上，RedFlow显著超越现有离线RL基线（真实成功率从56.7%提升至74.7%），并以约一个数量级更少的训练样本匹敌强在线方法（PPO、GRPO、DDPO）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配VLA策略在机器人操作中表现强劲，但部署时因分布偏移产生复合误差。离线RL虽可在 rollout 数据上提升策略，但现有方法要么忽略失败数据，要么仅在轨迹层面利用失败数据，导致学习效率低下且错误持续存在。因此需要一种更细粒度地利用失败数据的方法。

Method: RedFlow包含两个核心组件：（1）上下文感知校正匹配（Context-Aware Corrective Matching）机制，用于识别引发失败的动作并从相似上下文中检索成功替代动作作为校正目标；（2）自适应重定向目标（Adaptive Redirection Objective），同时强化成功动作、抑制不良动作，并将可恢复的失败动作重定向到校正目标。通过将成功与失败经验转化为稠密监督信号，实现混合质量数据下的鲁棒恢复学习。

Result: 在LIBERO基准和三个真实世界操作任务上，RedFlow一致优于最先进的离线RL基线，真实世界成功率从56.7%提升至74.7%；同时以约一个数量级更少的训练样本匹敌PPO、GRPO和DDPO等强在线方法。

Conclusion: RedFlow通过动作级别的细粒度离线RL框架，成功将失败经验转化为校正性监督，有效缓解了流匹配VLA策略的复合误差问题，实现了高效且鲁棒的策略改进，为混合质量数据下的离线RL提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation but often suffer from compounding errors caused by distribution shifts during deployment. While offline reinforcement learning (RL) provides a practical way to improve deployed policies using rollout data, existing methods either ignore failure data or exploit it only at the trajectory level, resulting in low learning efficiency and persistent errors. We propose **RedFlow**, a fine-grained offline RL framework that redirects failure experiences into action-level corrective supervision for flow-matching VLA policies. RedFlow consists of two key components: (1) a **Context-Aware Corrective Matching** mechanism that identifies failure-inducing actions and retrieves successful alternatives from similar contexts as corrective targets, and (2) an **Adaptive Redirection Objective** that jointly reinforces successful actions, suppresses undesirable ones, and redirects recoverable failures toward corrective targets. By converting both successful and failed experiences into dense supervision, RedFlow enables robust recovery learning from mixed-quality data. Experiments on the LIBERO benchmark and three real-world manipulation tasks show that RedFlow consistently outperforms state-of-the-art offline RL baselines, improving the real-world success rate from 56.7% to 74.7%. It also matches strong on-policy methods (PPO, GRPO, and DDPO) while requiring roughly an order of magnitude fewer training samples.

</details>


### [343] [DexDirect: Direct Kinesthetic Arm Guidance for Efficient Dexterous Demonstration Collection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27784)
*Beom Jun Kim,Shiu-Jen Wang,Jonathan Liu,Alvin Zhu,Quanyou Wang,Hanzhang Fang,Feng Xu,Mingzhang Zhu,Yuchen Cui,Dennis W. Hong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DexDirect是一种直接动觉手臂引导的灵巧操作演示采集接口，操作者通过手柄拖动6-DoF重力补偿机器人手臂，同时单个网络摄像头将另一只手重定向到16关节13-DoF灵巧手上。相比纯视觉和姿态追踪基线，成功演示数分别提升17.2倍和3.2倍，并显著降低认知负荷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作演示数据的可扩展采集是机器人学习的核心瓶颈。高保真接口需要昂贵硬件和复杂设置，而低成本替代方案控制精度低且增加操作者认知负担，亟需一种兼顾效率、精度与低设置成本的采集方案。

Method: 整合两条通道：1) 操作者通过手柄直接拖动6自由度重力补偿机械臂进行运动引导，提供直观的灵巧运动输入；2) 单个网络摄像头通过手部重定向将操作者的另一只手映射到16关节13自由度灵巧机器人手。用户研究和扩散策略训练验证该方法的有效性。

Result: 用户研究显示DexDirect相比纯视觉基线(AnyTeleop)和姿态追踪基线(TeleDex)分别多采集17.2倍和3.2倍的成功演示；NASA-TLX评估显示虽增加身体负荷，但显著降低心理需求、努力和挫败感；基于DexDirect演示训练的扩散策略在方块抓取放置任务中达到90%成功率。

Conclusion: 直接动觉手臂引导结合基于视觉的手部重定向是一种高效、低设置成本且可扩展的灵巧操作演示采集接口，有效解决了精度与易用性之间的权衡问题。

Abstract: Scalable collection of dexterous manipulation demonstrations remains a major bottleneck for robot learning. High-fidelity interfaces often require costly hardware and extensive setup, while low-setup, low cost alternatives tend to provide less precise control and impose greater cognitive workload on operators. We present DexDirect, a direct kinesthetic arm guidance for efficient dexterous demonstration collection. The operator drags a 6-DoF gravity-compensated robot arm directly by a handle, while a single webcam retargets operator's other hand onto a 16 joints 13-DoF dexterous robot hand. User studies suggest DexDirect collects 17.2x and 3.2x more successful demonstrations compared to purely vision (AnyTeleop) and pose-tracking (TeleDex) baselines. An adapted NASA-TLX shows DexDirect greatly reduces mental demand, effort, and frustration, despite raising physical demand. A diffusion policy trained on DexDirect demonstrations reaches a 90% success rate on a cube pick-and-place task. These results suggest that direct kinesthetic arm guidance combined with vision-based hand retargeting provides an efficient low-setup and scalable interface for collecting dexterous manipulation demonstrations

</details>


### [344] [RoboBRIDGE: A Modular Framework for Bridging Policies to Robust Real-World Robotic Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27881)
*Sihyung Yoon,Minjong Yoo,Sanghyun Ahn,Seojeong Choi,Honguk Woo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboBRIDGE是一个模块化框架，通过五个协调模块（Monitor、Perceptor、Planner、Controller、Robot Interface）将预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型系统性地转化为可靠的机器人智能体，解决现有VLA在失败恢复、长时程一致性和领域鲁棒性方面的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型虽然作为动作预测器很有效，但直接部署为机器人智能体存在关键缺陷：缺乏失败恢复机制、长时程执行不一致、对观测/任务/本体变化鲁棒性差。现有方法通过模型重训练或环境特定模块逐个解决这些问题，但缺乏一个统一的通用框架。

Method: 提出RoboBRIDGE模块化框架，在预训练VLA之上构建编排层，包含五个协调模块：Monitor负责快速失败检测与分层恢复；Perceptor基于环境偏离当前计划时异步更新场景理解；Planner在环境偏离计划时触发重新规划；Controller通过原始技能微调将操作分解为领域不变基元并使用专用LoRA适配器降低领域偏移敏感性；Robot Interface负责与机器人硬件交互。

Result: 在LIBERO、RoboCasa基准测试以及涵盖多种机器人平台和VLA主干的真实世界案例研究中，RoboBRIDGE一致性地优于独立策略和先前增强型VLA部署方案。

Conclusion: 可靠的机器人智能体能力并非仅来自扩展动作预测器的规模，而是来自围绕VLA的结构化编排（orchestration）。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have attracted growing interest as a scalable approach to robotic manipulation. While these models are effective action predictors, deploying them as robotic agents exposes critical gaps: no mechanism for failure recovery, inconsistent execution over long horizons, and limited robustness to shifts in observations, tasks, or embodiments. Existing solutions address these limitations individually through model retraining or environment-specific modules, yet what is needed is a general framework that systematically transforms a pretrained VLA into a robotic agent. We present RoboBRIDGE, a modular framework that provides an orchestration layer over five coordinated modules, namely Monitor, Perceptor, Planner, Controller, and Robot Interface, to compose robust robotic agents from off-the-shelf components, including pretrained VLAs. The Monitor pairs rapid failure detection with hierarchical recovery to correct errors before they cascade. When the environment diverges from the current plan, the Planner triggers replanning while the Perceptor updates scene understanding asynchronously, avoiding execution stalls. Within the Controller, primitive skill fine-tuning factors manipulation into domain-invariant primitives with dedicated LoRA adapters, reducing sensitivity to domain shifts when a VLA is used. Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and real-world case studies spanning multiple robot platforms and VLA backbones, RoboBRIDGE consistently outperforms both standalone policies and prior augmented VLA deployments. These results suggest that reliable robotic agency does not arise from scaling action predictors alone, but from structured orchestration around them.

</details>


### [345] [Static In, Dynamic Out: Counterfactual Action Augmentation for Moving Object Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27890)
*Woo Chul Shin,Zhenyang Chen,Alfred Cueva,Nadun Ranawaka Arachchige,Yingyan Celine Lin,Benjamin Joffe,Shreyas Kousik,Danfei Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SIDO是一种反事实动作增强方法，仅用静态物体演示训练的策略即可适应测试时未知的物体运动，通过在部署时预测物体未来位置并保持手-物相对位姿来生成目标条件策略，在三个模拟任务和两个真实任务中优于基线且不影响静态性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉运动策略在操作任务中假定目标物体在执行过程中保持静止，但真实场景（如传送带上的零件、风中摇晃的水果）中物体会运动，导致策略部署失效。因此需要一种无需额外动态演示数据即可适应物体运动的方法。

Method: 将移动物体操作分解为两个子问题：预测物体未来位置，以及到达该预测位姿。SIDO将物体位移到反事实的未来位置，并将演示的动作块进行变形以保持手-物相对位姿，从而构建目标条件策略；部署时由物体位姿预测器提供未来位置。

Result: 在三个模拟任务（Mug、Square、Stack）的5种物体运动模式以及两个真实任务（Gantry、Peachtree）中，SIDO相比基线提升了移动物体的成功率，同时保持了静态物体的操作性能。

Conclusion: 通过将移动物体操作分解为位置预测与到达预测位姿两个子问题，并用反事实动作增强实现数据高效迁移，SIDO使仅由静态演示训练的策略能泛化到未知的物体运动场景，实现了静态与动态性能的兼顾。

Abstract: Visuomotor policies have advanced on manipulation tasks where the target object stays static during execution, but real deployments break this assumption: parts drift on conveyors and fruits sway in the wind. We introduce Static In, Dynamic Out (SIDO), a counterfactual action augmentation that enables a policy trained only on static object demonstrations to adapt to unseen object motion at test time. Our key idea is to factorize moving object manipulation into two sub-problems: predicting where the object will be, and reaching that predicted pose. SIDO displaces the object to a counterfactual future position and morphs the demonstrated action chunk to preserve the hand-object relative pose, yielding a goal-conditioned policy. At deployment an object pose predictor supplies the future position. Across three simulated tasks (Mug, Square, Stack) under five object motion patterns and two real-world tasks (Gantry, Peachtree), SIDO improves moving object success over the baselines while preserving static object performance. Project website: https://sido-staticindynamicout.github.io/.

</details>


### [346] [Learning Social Robot Navigation By Sensing Human Legs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27922)
*Alberto Vaglio,Andrea Garulli,Antonio Giannitrapani,Renato Quartullo,Tommaso Van Der Meer*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CALF（Convolutional Attention for Leg Features），一种端到端神经网络架构，直接从2D LiDAR扫描中的腿部运动生成安全导航命令。搭配自定义轻量级模拟器LegNav（含新型行人步态模型）进行深度强化学习训练，并在TurtleBot 4上实现零样本真实世界部署，训练时间不到一小时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在地面附近安装2D LiDAR进行行人导航时，传感器主要看到的是移动的腿部而非整个人体，但现有基于学习的导航方法仍将行人简化为圆形等简单形状，存在感知与建模之间的明显差距。

Method: CALF采用卷积层、注意力机制和MLP的组合架构，直接从LiDAR扫描中解释腿部运动。使用深度强化学习算法在LegNav（一个用JAX编写的轻量级2D模拟器，结合2D LiDAR光线追踪与新型行人步态模型）中训练策略。

Result: CALF策略在导航性能和社会合规性方面优于经典与基于学习的基线方法，并在TurtleBot 4上通过零样本部署成功完成真实世界实验，生成平滑且符合社会规范的轨迹。LegNav使部署就绪的CALF策略可在单张消费级GPU上于一小时内完成训练。

Conclusion: CALF证明了直接利用LiDAR腿部运动特征进行行人感知和导航的可行性与有效性，且LegNav模拟器的高效性使得从训练到真实部署的流程极其快捷，为实际机器人导航提供了一个实用且训练高效的方案。

Abstract: Robots navigating among pedestrians typically sense their surroundings with a 2D LiDAR mounted close to the ground. At that height, the sensor mostly sees moving legs rather than whole people, yet most learning-based navigation methods still treat pedestrians as simple shapes like circles. This paper addresses that gap with CALF (Convolutional Attention for Leg Features), an end-to-end neural architecture that combines convolutional layers, attention, and MLP to interpret leg motion directly from LiDAR scans and produce safe navigation commands. The CALF policy is trained using deep reinforcement learning algorithms within LegNav, a custom lightweight 2D simulator that combines 2D LiDAR ray tracing with a novel pedestrian gait model. The resulting policy is compared against classical and learning-based baselines in terms of navigation performance and social compliance. The approach is validated through real-world experiments via zero-shot deployment on a TurtleBot 4, yielding smooth and socially compliant trajectories. Written in JAX, the LegNav simulator enables the training of a deployment-ready CALF policy in under an hour on a single consumer GPU.

</details>


### [347] [RaDiVe: Robust 4D Radar Odometry with Distance-Bounded NDT and Velocity-Discrepancy Point Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28045)
*Sangwoo Jung,Dongjae Lee,Chiyun Noh,Ayoung Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RaDiVe是一个4D雷达里程计框架，通过距离受限的NDT、速度差异点不确定性模型和基于SDF的隐式神经表面点提取，在多种公开数据集上将平移ATE和旋转ATE分别平均降低44.4%和21.3%，同时保持实时性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D雷达虽能在恶劣天气下提供鲁棒感知，但其点云的稀疏性、噪声和有限的位置精度使得基于配准的里程计面临显著挑战，需要设计更稳健的配准方法。

Method: 1) 提出距离受限NDT，仅搜索近距离体素对以提升优化稳定性和计算效率；2) 提出速度差异点不确定性模型，根据测量多普勒径向速度与由估计自车速预测的径向速度之间的差异对每个点加权；3) 通过隐式神经映射引入基于SDF的表面点提取，构建几何一致且噪声过滤的局部子地图。

Result: 在多个公开数据集上，RaDiVe较现有4D雷达里程计基线在平移ATE上平均提升44.4%，在旋转ATE上平均提升21.3%，且保持实时运行。

Conclusion: RaDiVe通过组合改进的NDT配准、速度差异驱动的点加权和神经SDF表面提取，有效提升了4D雷达里程计在复杂环境下的精度与鲁棒性，源码将开源供机器人社区使用。

Abstract: Recent advances in 4D radar enable robust perception in adverse weather; however, the inherent sparsity, noise, and limited positional precision of radar point clouds pose significant challenges for registration-based odometry. In this letter, we propose RaDiVe, a 4D radar odometry framework designed to improve the accuracy and robustness of radar point-cloud registration. We introduce a distance-bounded Normal Distributions Transform (NDT), which improves optimization stability and computational efficiency by restricting the correspondence search to near-distance voxel pairs. To mitigate measurement ambiguity, we propose a velocity-discrepancy point uncertainty model that weights each input 4D radar point according to the discrepancy between its measured Doppler radial velocity and the radial velocity predicted from the estimated ego-velocity. Furthermore, we incorporate Signed Distance Function (SDF)-based surface point extraction via implicit neural mapping to construct a geometrically consistent and noise-filtered local submap. Evaluations across multiple public datasets demonstrate that RaDiVe outperforms existing 4D radar odometry baselines by 44.4% in translational Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) and 21.3% in rotational ATE on average, while maintaining real-time performance. The source code will be made publicly available to the robotics community: https://github.com/to-be-open-sourced.

</details>


### [348] [UniCross: Unified Cross-Skill Dexterous Manipulation Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28198)
*Hui Zhang,Julian Ferchow,Jie Song,Mirko Meboldt*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，将灵巧操作中的四种核心技能（抓取、重定位、手内旋转、手内平移）建模为单一公式，共享相同的状态空间、动作空间和共同的目标结构，从而支持跨技能策略蒸馏、跨形态迁移以及长时程技能组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的灵巧操作方法将抓取、重定位、手内旋转、手内平移等技能分开建模，各自采用不同的动作约束、目标函数甚至专用的手部形态，破坏了技能组合所需的兼容性和连续性，难以实现长时程操作任务的组合展开。

Method: 构建一个统一框架，将四种灵巧操作技能纳入单一公式，四种技能共享相同的状态空间、动作空间和目标结构；基于该统一公式对单一跨技能策略进行蒸馏，使其在每个技能上表现出色。

Result: 统一策略在各项技能上均表现优异，泛化到未见物体，对扰动保持鲁棒性，能无缝衔接各技能以完成长时程操作，且框架可跨不同手部形态有效迁移。

Conclusion: 不同灵巧操作技能可视为共享任务公式的实例化，揭示了不同行为之间内在的一致性，为统一建模灵巧操作提供了新思路。

Abstract: Many dexterous manipulation tasks require the object to remain securely held throughout the interaction. From the perspective of hand-object relational motion, such manipulation comprises four canonical skills: grasping, relocation, in-hand rotation, and in-hand translation. Human hands flexibly compose these skills to accomplish complex tasks. Existing approaches, however, model these skills separately with skill-specific action constraints, objectives, or even dedicated hand morphologies, which breaks the compatibility and continuity required for long-horizon composition. In this work, we present a unified framework that models all four skills in a single formulation that shares the same state and action spaces and a common objective structure. This formulation enables straightforward distillation of a single cross-skill policy that performs strongly on every skill, generalizes to unseen objects, stays robust to disturbances, and chains skills seamlessly into long-horizon manipulation. The framework also transfers effectively across different hand morphologies. Overall, our results suggest that different dexterous manipulation skills can be viewed as instantiations of a shared task formulation, revealing the intrinsic consistency across different behaviors.

</details>


### [349] [When Robots Exchange Meaning: A Demo of Goal-Oriented Semantic Communications for Collaborative Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28256)
*Peizheng Li,Xinyi Lin,Sajida Gufran,Adnan Aijaz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个机器人-边缘语义通信（SemCom）测试平台，将机器人端视觉压缩（VQ-VAE）、边缘端语义建图（RTAB-Map）和仪表盘交互集成于一体，作为协作机器人6G场景的演示系统。RGB图像在机器人端编码为VQ-VAE token（320×240图像压缩42.67倍），在边缘端解码后结合深度、位姿与3D建图信息生成语义地图，为任务感知的6G网络研究提供了端到端平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协作机器人作为面向任务的6G典型用例，其通信质量评估不应仅关注分组交付，而应反映在任务执行、环境理解和闭环操作中。现有测试平台缺乏将语义通信与机器人任务执行相结合的实际验证环境。

Method: 构建机器人-边缘语义通信测试平台：移动机器人搭载RGB-D传感器和LiDAR运行ROS 2；Jetson Orin边缘节点负责视觉重建、RTAB-Map语义建图、语义物体处理和浏览器可视化；RGB帧在机器人端通过ONNX Runtime编码器压缩为VQ-VAE tokens（320×240图像表示为80×60 token网格，5400字节承载，相较模型输入RGB实现42.67倍压缩），边缘端用PyTorch解码器重建，并与深度、位姿和3D建图信息融合生成语义地图。

Result: 实现了320×240图像42.67倍压缩率的端到端语义视觉传输；验证了从语义视觉传输到物体级地图交互的完整链路；搭建了可用于6G网络研究的实践平台。

Conclusion: 该演示平台打通了从语义视觉传输到物体级地图交互的全流程，为将来在语义通信、具身AI和物理AI驱动的机器人交叉领域的任务感知6G网络研究提供了实践平台。

Abstract: Collaborative robotics is a representative task-oriented 6G use-case, where communication quality should be reflected in mission execution, environment understanding, and closed-loop operation rather than packet delivery alone. This demo paper presents a robot-edge semantic communication (SemCom) testbed integrating robot-side visual compression, edge-side semantic mapping, and dashboard-based mission interaction. A mobile robot equipped with RGB-D sensing and LiDAR runs ROS 2, while a Jetson Orin edge node performs reconstruction, RTAB-Map mapping, semantic object handling, and browserbased visualization. As an initial proof of concept, RGB frames are encoded on the robot into VQ-VAE tokens using an ONNX Runtime encoder and reconstructed on the edge using a PyTorch decoder. A 320 X 240 image is represented by an 80 X 60 token grid with a packed payload of 5400 bytes, corresponding to a 42.67X reduction relative to model-input RGB bytes. The reconstructed visual stream is further associated with depth, pose, and 3D mapping information to generate a semantic map for downstream robotic applications. The demo exposes the full path from semantic visual transport to object-level map interaction, and provides a practical platform for future task-aware 6G networking studies at the intersection of SemCom, embodied AI, and physical AI-enabled robotics. A video of the demo is available at https://tinyurl.com/Tos09

</details>


### [350] [SemAnCorr: Semantic Anchored Correspondence for Zero-Shot Manipulation Skill Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28382)
*Xiaoxiang Dong,William Baron,Hongyi Chen,Uksang Yoo,Jeffrey Ichnowski,Weiming Zhi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SemAnCorr是一个无需训练的框架，通过联合位姿-对应优化选择语义一致的锚点区域，并利用函数映射在物体表面传播约束，建立同时保持语义一致性和几何一致性的稠密对应，从而实现跨不同几何形状但功能相同的物体间的零样本操作技能迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于稠密视觉描述符和3D特征场的对应方法使用最近邻特征匹配，容易产生空间上不连贯的对应关系，无法恢复技能迁移所需的局部几何坐标系。这阻碍了操作技能在不同几何形状但功能相同的物体实例间可靠迁移。

Method: SemAnCorr包含三个关键组件：(1) 通过联合位姿-对应优化选择语义一致的锚点区域；(2) 利用函数映射（functional maps）将锚点约束在物体表面上传播，建立稠密对应；(3) 该框架是训练无关的（training-free），无需额外训练数据。由此得到的对应关系同时保语义一致性与几何一致性，支持物体中心化的操作技能迁移。

Result: 在基于PartNet-Mobility构建的稠密对应基准上，SemAnCorr达到90.8%的语义准确率，并在几何一致性上优于近期最先进的基线方法。在真实世界实验中，仅需单次演示，SemAnCorr即可实现比现有对应方法显著更可靠的零样本操作技能迁移到未见过的物体。

Conclusion: 通过同时优化语义一致性和几何连贯性，SemAnCorr有效解决了跨几何异构物体间操作技能迁移的关键难题，其在基准测试和真实机器人实验中均展现出优越性能，为通用操作技能迁移提供了一种无需训练的高效解决方案。

Abstract: Transferring manipulation skills across object instances that share functionality but differ in geometry remains a fundamental challenge in robot learning. While recent correspondence methods leverage dense visual descriptors and 3D feature fields, nearest-neighbor feature matching often produces spatially incoherent correspondences that fail to recover the local geometric frames required for reliable skill transfer. We introduce SemAnCorr, a training-free framework that establishes dense correspondence by selecting semantically consistent anchor regions through joint pose-correspondence optimization and propagating these constraints over the object surface using functional maps. The resulting correspondences preserve both semantic consistency and geometric coherence, enabling object-centric manipulation skills to transfer across geometrically diverse instances. We evaluate SemAnCorr on a dense correspondence benchmark built on PartNet-Mobility, achieving 90.8% semantic accuracy in our benchmark evaluation while improving geometric coherence over recent state-of-the-art baselines. Finally, we show that these improvements translate directly into real-world manipulation performance: using a single demonstration, SemAnCorr enables substantially more reliable zero-shot manipulation skill transfer to previously unseen objects than existing correspondence methods. Videos and additional visualizations are available at [https://semancorr.github.io](https://semancorr.github.io) .

</details>


### [351] [TacWAM: Anchor-Guided World Action Model with Mechanics-Aware Tactile Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28391)
*Lei Jin,Yiding Ma,Xin Zhang,Chen Gao,Wei Wu,Yong Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TacWAM是一个力学感知的触觉世界动作模型，通过空间对齐融合触觉编码器、触觉历史编码器和锚点引导的三模态注意力，将未来触觉预测作为监督信号而不作为动作生成的直接线索，在四个真实世界的接触丰富操作任务上达到75.0%的平均成功率，超过最强基线37.5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的世界动作模型主要依赖视觉未来预测来监督动作学习，但视觉预测难以捕捉力、形变、剪切和滑动等接触丰富操作中的关键物理信息。这要求触觉未来预测既要携带有意义的物理信息，又不能成为动作生成的特权线索（即在部署时不可用）。

Method: TacWAM分三步解决：1）空间对齐融合（SAF）触觉编码器将触觉外观、密集力场和形变流映射到共享潜在预测空间，并通过双边力和力矩重建保留全局接触信息；2）触觉历史编码器提供时间上下文，使未来触觉预测反映力和形变超越当前观测的变化；3）锚点引导三模态（AGT）注意力将当前视觉/触觉锚点、未来预测token和动作token分离，使未来触觉状态监督训练但不被动作分支直接读取。

Result: 在四个真实世界的接触丰富操作任务（包括脆弱抓取、持续表面接触和动态手中操作）上，TacWAM达到75.0%的平均成功率，超过最强基线37.5个百分点。消融实验表明，移除触觉历史或放宽未来预测目标访问权限时性能一致下降。

Conclusion: 未来触觉监督在结合有信息量的触觉表示和部署一致的（deployment-consistent）信息约束时，可以有效提升接触感知的动作学习效果。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) combine future-state prediction with robot action generation, but existing approaches largely rely on visual futures. Visual prediction captures scene structure and object motion, yet provides limited supervision for force, deformation, shear, and slip during contact-rich manipulation. This creates two design requirements: tactile futures should carry meaningful physical information, and they should not become privileged cues for action generation. We present TacWAM, a mechanics-aware tactile WAM that addresses this challenge in three steps. First, a Spatially Aligned Fusion (SAF) Tactile Encoder maps tactile appearance, dense force fields, and deformation flow into a shared latent prediction space, with bilateral force and torque reconstruction preserving global contact information. Second, a tactile history encoder provides temporal context so future tactile prediction reflects how force and deformation change beyond the current tactile observation. Third, Anchor-Guided Tri-Modal (AGT) Attention separates current visual and tactile anchors, future prediction tokens, and action tokens, allowing future tactile states to supervise training without being directly read by the action branch. We evaluate TacWAM on four real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks covering fragile grasping, sustained surface contact, and dynamic in-hand manipulation. TacWAM achieves an average success rate of 75.0%, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 37.5 percentage points. Staged ablations show consistent degradation when tactile history is removed and access to future prediction targets is relaxed. These results indicate that future tactile supervision can improve contact-aware action learning when combined with informative tactile representations and deployment-consistent information constraints.

</details>


### [352] [FasTac: A Curved Multispectral Vision-Based Tactile Sensor for High-Speed High-Precision 3D Shape and Force Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28416)
*Xiaofan Lu,Kaiji Huang,Jiahui Chen,Yuankai Lin,Hua Yang,Zhouping Yin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FasTac是一款曲面视觉触觉传感器，通过多光谱光度立体视觉、动态卷积力估计和FPGA硬件加速，在紧凑外形下实现了精确3D重建、三轴力估计和高速处理，深度MAE从0.2730mm降至0.0415mm，处理延迟从3.26ms降至1.09ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有曲面视觉触觉传感器难以在紧凑体积内同时兼顾精确的3D重建、三轴力估计和高速处理。本文旨在解决这一多目标冲突问题，实现高分辨率几何感知、法向与切向力区分以及瞬态信号捕获的能力。

Method: 1) 利用单片图像传感器同时进行多光谱成像，提供空间对齐的多光谱观测用于鲁棒表面法线估计；2) 采用边界先验的快速泊松深度重建算法；3) 提出HyperForce模块，使用位置感知动态卷积来建模曲面弹性体的空间非均匀力学响应并估计三轴力；4) 将完整的图像到法线到力的管线部署在FPGA上实现硬件加速。

Result: NIR照明和边界先验使深度MAE从0.2730mm降至0.0415mm；HyperForce在法向力和剪切力估计上分别达到2.74%和2.39%的NMAE；FPGA部署将处理延迟从GPU的3.26ms缩短至1.09ms。多目标重建、反馈抓取和振动测量验证了细粒度几何感知、稳定力反馈和动态接触传感能力。

Conclusion: FasTac通过硬件级加速与算法创新的协同设计，成功在一个紧凑的曲面触觉传感器中同时实现高精度3D重建、三轴力估计和低延迟处理，为灵巧操作的触觉感知提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Curved tactile fingertips for dexterous manipulation must resolve fine contact geometry, distinguish normal and tangential loads, and capture transient signals. Existing curved vision-based tactile sensors struggle to combine accurate 3D reconstruction, three-axis force estimation, and high-speed processing in a compact form. This article presents FasTac, a curved vision-based tactile sensor integrating multispectral photometric stereo, dynamic-convolution force estimation, and hardware acceleration on a field-programmable gate array (FPGA). Single-image-sensor simultaneous multispectral imaging provides spatially aligned observations for robust surface normal estimation, followed by boundary-prior fast Poisson depth reconstruction. HyperForce uses position-aware dynamic convolution to model the spatially nonuniform mechanical response of curved elastomers and estimate three-axis forces. The complete image-to-normal-force pipeline is deployed on an FPGA. Experiments show that near-infrared (NIR) illumination and the boundary prior decrease depth mean absolute error (MAE) from 0.2730 mm to 0.0415 mm; HyperForce achieves normalized mean absolute error (NMAE) values of 2.74% and 2.39% for normal and shear forces, respectively; and FPGA deployment shortens processing latency from 3.26 ms on the GPU to 1.09 ms. Multi-object reconstruction, feedback grasping, and vibration measurement validate fine geometric perception, stable force feedback, and dynamic contact sensing.

</details>


### [353] [One Future, Every Robot: Label-Efficient Collective-State Prediction with Decentralized JEPA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28443)
*Alan-Barsag Gazzaev,Alexey Garvilov,Sergey Muravyov*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出集体状态JEPA（CS-JEPA），一种递归联合嵌入预测架构，使蜂群中的每个机器人仅通过局部观测和带宽有限的通信消息，就能预测相同的未来集体状态，并在拓扑与规模变化下展现出标签高效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分布式蜂群系统中，每个机器人需要预测整个群体的未来集体状态，但只能依赖局部观测和带宽有限的通信。现有方法要么依赖全局池化、目标编码器或记录的未来动作等不现实的条件，要么需要大量标签数据。因此需要一种无需这些理想化假设、且标签高效的分散式共享状态预测方法。

Method: CS-JEPA是一种循环联合嵌入预测架构：每台机器人在部署时使用16帧局部历史序列和一个每条有向边64浮点数的循环消息，通过联合嵌入预测架构预测共同未来token场。没有全局池化、目标编码器、事件时钟或记录的未来动作。预训练阶段不使用下游集体标签，冻结表示通过岭回归探针进行评估。还进行了动作条件化的扩展，将候选四步计划输入预测器生成接收方局部预测表示。

Result: 与采用相同接收端锚点和部署容量但多出9,607个训练参数的原生未来重建方法相比：前瞻性五种子后续实验在预测误差和机器人间一致性标签预算AUC上均有改善，覆盖in-distribution、ring、mutual-kNN和unseen-size家族，最多108个机器人，所有效果在5/5外层种子上支持CS-JEPA。在独立的封存八种子后续实验中，动作条件化预测器将分支值MSE降低45.5%，候选评分皮尔逊相关提升0.1291，两个效果在8/8种子上均有利，包括未见N=32的情况。

Conclusion: 共同未来JEPA目标可作为分散式蜂群预测中标签高效的基础原语，在拓扑与规模变化下表现出色，并额外提供具有规划价值的价值估计能力。

Abstract: Can every robot in a swarm predict the same future collective state from only local observations and bandwidth-limited messages? We formulate this as decentralized shared-state prediction and introduce Collective-State JEPA (CS-JEPA), a recurrent joint-embedding predictive architecture whose output at every robot represents one common future token field. At deployment, each robot uses a 16-frame local history and one 64-float recurrent message per directed edge; there is no global pooling, target encoder, episode clock, or recorded future action. After pretraining without downstream collective labels, frozen representations are evaluated with ridge probes fitted on 6, 12, or 24 globally labeled episodes. Against raw-future reconstruction with the same receiver anchor and deployment capacity but 9,607 additional training-only parameters, a prospectively registered five-seed follow-up improves prediction-error and inter-robot-agreement label-budget AUC on in-distribution, ring, mutual-kNN, and unseen-size families up to 108 robots. Every effect favors CS-JEPA in 5/5 outer seeds. In a separate sealed eight-seed follow-up, matched action-conditioned predictors receive each candidate four-step plan before producing receiver-local predictive representations. CS-JEPA reduces branch-value MSE by 45.5% and improves within-context candidate-score Pearson correlation by 0.1291, with both effects favorable in 8/8 seeds, including at unseen N=32. These results support common-future JEPA targets as a label-efficient primitive for decentralized swarm prediction under topology and size shift, with additional evidence of planning-relevant value estimation.

</details>


### [354] [Machines that know they are aging: a framework for hardware-aware autonomous intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28451)
*Cheng Siong Chin,Jianhua Zhang,Mohan Venkateshkumar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出老化感知自主智能（AAAI）框架，将硬件健康状态直接集成到自主系统的推理、规划和任务执行中，通过三大支柱（硬件自我感知、自适应推理、生存中心智能）构建闭环认知架构，使机器能够识别并对自身老化做出响应，从而提升弹性、延长运行寿命并支持更安全、优雅的任务完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主系统随时间必然老化（电池退化、传感器漂移、处理器定时误差积累、内存可靠性下降），但传统AI假定硬件保持原始状态，导致假设能力与实际能力之间的失配日益扩大，进而引发"不可知崩溃"——即由累积硬件退化而非单一部件故障导致的任务失败。

Method: AAAI框架建立在三大支柱之上：(1) 硬件自我感知——利用物理失效模型持续估计电源、传感、内存和计算子系统的健康状况；(2) 自适应推理——根据剩余硬件能力调整推理复杂度、规划周期和任务优先级；(3) 生存中心智能——通过性能优化、资源节约和优雅降级在任务目标间分配剩余运行寿命。该框架将预测与健康管理、生命周期管理和硬件感知计算统一为闭环认知架构。

Result: 论文论证了将硬件老化感知集成到自主系统推理中的必要性，指出该框架适用于各不可达或安全关键环境（太空任务、海洋机器人、植入式医疗设备），通过让机器认知和响应自身老化，提升系统弹性、延长运行寿命并支持更安全、优雅的任务完成。

Conclusion: 针对不可达或安全关键环境中的自主系统，硬件老化感知的集成是必不可少的，AAAII通过闭环认知架构将机器自身老化纳入决策过程，实现更可靠、更长寿、更安全的自主运行。

Abstract: Autonomous systems inevitably age, yet their artificial intelligence typically assumes hardware remains in its original condition. Batteries degrade, sensors drift, processors accumulate timing errors, and memory reliability declines, creating a growing mismatch between assumed and actual capability. This can lead to agnostic collapse, where mission failure arises from accumulated hardware degradation rather than a single component fault. We propose Aging-Aware Autonomous Intelligence (AAAI), a framework that integrates hardware health directly into reasoning, planning, and mission execution. AAAI is built on three pillars: hardware self-awareness, which continuously estimates the health of power, sensing, memory, and computation subsystems using physics-of-failure models; self-adaptive reasoning, which adjusts inference complexity, planning horizon, and task priorities according to remaining hardware capability; and survival-centric intelligence, which allocates remaining operational life across mission objectives through performance optimization, resource conservation, and graceful degradation. Rather than introducing new hardware, AAAI unifies prognostics, lifecycle management, and hardware-aware computing into a closed-loop cognitive architecture. We argue that such integration is essential for autonomous systems operating in inaccessible or safety-critical environments, including space missions, marine robotics, and implantable medical devices. By enabling machines to recognize and respond to their own aging, AAAI improves resilience, extends operational lifetime, and supports safer, more graceful mission completion.

</details>


### [355] [TEA-AgriVLN: Traversability Estimation Alarm for Agricultural Vision-and-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28474)
*Xiaobei Zhao,Xingqi Lyu,Xin Chen,Xiang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对连续环境视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）在农业场景中的地面临界可穿越性模糊问题，提出TEA模块估计相机图像的可穿越性，并在预测动作与可穿越性图不一致时提醒决策者重新思考。将TEA集成到AgriVLN骨干架构中得到TEA-AgriVLN方法，在A2A基准上将成功率从0.47提升至0.54，导航误差从2.91m降至2.70m，达到农业VLN-CE领域的最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将VLN-CE从室内场景扩展到农业场景时，发现室内场景中区域是否可穿越通常分类明确（如木地板可穿越、混凝土墙不可穿越），而农业场景中这一判断往往模糊（如未成熟玉米地对机器狗可穿越但对人类不可穿越）。这种模糊性对导航决策造成挑战，需要专门的方法来处理。

Method: 提出TEA（Traversability Estimation and Alarm）模块，包含两部分：1）估计相机图像的可穿越性并生成可穿越性图；2）当预测的动作与可穿越性图不一致时，向决策者发出警报促使其重新思考。将TEA模块集成到AgriVLN骨干架构中，构建TEA-AgriVLN方法。

Result: 在A2A基准上评估，TEA-AgriVLN将成功率（SR）从0.47提升到0.54，导航误差（NE)从2.91米降低到2.70米，在农业VLN-CE领域取得最先进（SOTA）性能。此外还进行了消融研究和案例研究，探讨了TEA在不同地面类别和场景类别上的有效性与局限性。

Conclusion: TEA-AgriVLN通过引入可穿越性估计与警报机制，有效解决了农业场景中地面可穿越性模糊的问题，显著提升了农业VLN-CE的导航性能，并开源了代码供后续研究使用。

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an agent to follow a natural language instruction, predicting a sequence of low-level actions to navigate a robot from a starting point to a target location. The A2A benchmark and the AgriVLN method pioneeringly extended VLN-CE from indoor scenes to agricultural scenes, while we observed a challenging distinction: In indoor scenes, whether a zone is traversable tends to be clear to classify, such as wood floors are traversable but concrete walls are not. In agricultural scenes, however, this issue tends to be ambiguous, such as an unripe cornfield might be traversable for a robotic dog but might be non-traversable for a human. To address this issue, we propose the TEA module, which estimates the traversability of the camera image, then alarm the decision-maker for rethinking when the predicted action does not align with the traversability map. We integrate it into the AgriVLN backbone to build our TEA-AgriVLN method. When evaluated on A2A, it improves Success Rate (SR) from 0.47 to 0.54 and Navigation Error (NE) from 2.91 m to 2.70 m, showing the state-of-the-art performance in the agricultural VLN-CE domain. We further implement the ablation studies and the case study, discussing the effectiveness and limitations of TEA on different ground categories and scene classes. Code: https://github.com/AlexTraveling/TEA-AgriVLN.

</details>


### [356] [X-NavDP: Generalizing Navigation Diffusion Policy to Novel Behavior and Embodiments with Group Q-score Reweighted Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28560)
*Tianyu Yang,Yiming Zeng,Wenzhe Cai,Yuqiang Yang,Jiaqi Peng,Hui Cheng,Jiangmiao Pang,Tai Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出GQRM框架，一种数据高效的扩散策略RL后训练框架，通过自引导探索与分组Q-score归一化重加权匹配，对预训练的导航扩散策略进行跨形态在线RL微调，得到X-NavDP策略，在仿真和真实世界环境中显著提升跨形态视觉导航成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练导航扩散策略依赖大规模专家演示，但这些数据通常由面向单一标称机器人的全知oracle规划器生成，限制了策略对多样形态机器人和挑战性场景（如死胡同逃脱、长障碍绕行）的泛化能力。后训练中引入RL虽然理论上可行，但扩散策略的不可解似然导致策略梯度不稳定，且探索效率低下，使得先前RL方法仅能获得边际改进。

Method: 提出GQRM框架，包含两个互补设计：(i) 自引导探索策略（self-bootstrapped exploration）结合行为扰动，保留预训练策略的先验；(ii) 分组Q-score归一化机制（group Q-score normalization），在每个状态上计算每条轨迹的值，用于高效的重加权得分匹配（reweighted score matching）。通过在异构形态上进行分布式在线RL训练来微调策略。

Result: 微调后的策略X-NavDP在跨形态视觉导航任务上取得最先进水平，仿真总体成功率从61.20%提升至84.28%，真实世界困难场景成功率从10%提升至65%。

Conclusion: GQRM框架通过保护预训练先验的探索策略和分组Q-score归一化重加权匹配机制，有效解决了扩散策略RL后训练中策略梯度不稳定和探索效率低的问题，在跨形态导航上取得了显著性能提升，证明了该方法的有效性和数据效率。

Abstract: Pretraining navigation diffusion policies rely on large-scale expert demonstrations. These data are typically generated by a fully-informed oracle planner suited to a single nominal robot. This limits the policy's generalization to diverse embodiments and challenging scenarios (e.g., escaping dead ends or detouring long obstacles) that demand diverse local reactive behaviors with only onboard local observations. Post-training the policy with reinforcement learning (RL) offers a principled remedy. However, previous RL for diffusion approaches lead to only marginal improvements. This is because the intractable likelihood of diffusion policies renders policy gradients unstable in addition to inefficient policy exploration. To address these challenges, we propose a data-efficient diffusion RL post-training framework - GQRM (Group Q-score Reweighted Matching). Our framework introduces two complementary designs: (i) a self-bootstrapped exploration strategy with behavior perturbation that preserves the pretrained policy prior, and (ii) a group Q-score normalization mechanism that computes per-trajectory values on each state for efficient reweighted score matching. By conducting distributed online RL training across heterogeneous embodiments, the resulting fine-tuned policy, X-NavDP, achieves state-of-the-art cross-embodiment visual navigation performance, improving the overall success rate from 61.20% to 84.28% in simulation and 10% to 65% in real-world hard cases. The code and model are publicly available at https://yty-sky.github.io/x-navdp-project-page.

</details>


### [357] [FA-RDP: A Frequency-Adaptive Reactive Diffusion Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28596)
*Lifeng Zhuo,Wendi Chen,Han Xue,Shirun Tang,Jun Lv,Cewu Lu,Chuan Wen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FA-RDP提出了一种频率自适应的反应式扩散策略，通过共享多频率视觉-力Transformer预测动作块，并利用学习到的多模态指示器在接触前使用多步低频采样以保留动作多样性、接触后切换到单步高频采样以提升对力反馈的响应速度，解决了标准扩散策略在保模态与反应性之间的固有权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在接触丰富的操作任务中，同一回合的不同阶段存在截然不同的需求：接触前动作具有多模态性，需要保留多种可行轨迹；接触后解空间收窄，但对力反馈的反应速度至关重要。标准扩散策略使用固定的推断频率和采样步数，导致低频率多步采样虽能保留接触前多模态性但响应缓慢，高频率采样虽反应快却易导致接触前模态坍缩，二者不可兼得。

Method: 1）提出FA-RDP架构，采用共享的多频率视觉-力Transformer，同时预测低频和高频两个频率下的动作块；2）引入可学习的多模态指示器，动态选择接触前的多步低频采样以及接触后动作歧义降低时的单步高频采样；3）提出流形一致性蒸馏（MCD），将扩散网络重新参数化以在机器人动作流形上预测动作，同时保留基于DDPM的残差监督。

Result: 在三个接触丰富的操作任务上，FA-RDP取得了最高的成功率的，同时保留了接触前多样的轨迹模式。

Conclusion: FA-RDP通过频率自适应机制有效平衡了接触前动作多模态保留与接触后力反馈响应速度之间的权衡，验证了动态切换采样频率与步数策略在接触丰富操作任务中的有效性。

Abstract: In contact-rich manipulation, action multimodality and reactivity dominate different stages of a single episode. Before contact, multiple trajectories might be equally valid, making it important to preserve diverse action modes. After contact, geometric constraints and force limits narrow the solution space, while successful execution demands rapid responses to force feedback. However, standard diffusion policies use a fixed inference frequency and sampling steps throughout the episode, forcing a fundamental compromise: low-frequency, multi-step sampling better preserves pre-contact multimodality but responds slowly to force feedback, whereas high-frequency sampling improves reactivity but tends to collapse distinct pre-contact modes. To resolve this tradeoff, we present FA-RDP, a frequency-adaptive reactive diffusion policy. A shared multi-frequency visual-force Transformer predicts action chunks at both low and high frequencies, while a learned multimodality indicator dynamically selects multi-step low-frequency sampling before contact and one-step high-frequency sampling as action ambiguity decreases. We further introduce Manifold Consistency Distillation (MCD), which reparameterizes the diffusion network to predict actions on the robot action manifold while retaining DDPM-based residual supervision. Experiments on three contact-rich manipulation tasks show that FA-RDP achieves the highest success rate while preserving diverse pre-contact trajectory modes. Code and videos are available at https://fa-rdp.github.io.

</details>
